title: Full-Stack Developer - Barcelona
content: Our client is a vertically integrated Earth Observation company that designs, manufactures, and operates satellite systems, delivering decision-grade insights at scale to government and commercial customers. They build space systems end-to-end, from satellite design and manufacturing to launch and on-orbit operations, giving the ability to deploy quickly, operate reliably, and support persistent monitoring across regions and priority areas. Their approach moves customers beyond one-off imagery toward continuous awareness and alert-driven decision-making, with flexible pathways that can evolve from managed monitoring to full satellite ownership and sovereign control. Their technology supports a wide range of use cases across climate monitoring, agriculture, energy, infrastructure, defense and intelligence, helping organizations detect change, manage risk, and plan with confidence. With a team distributed across five countries, the company brings together expertise in satellite engineering, software development, data science, manufacturing, operations, and go-to-market. They’re a group of purpose-driven builders who value ownership, curiosity, and execution—and who work with humility, honesty, and empathy. About the Team The Platform is the customer interface for all of their products. The team is responsible for developing the platform's core services, APIs, and applications that define, market, and deliver these products. They collaborate closely with Sales, Mission Operations, Tasking, and Image Processing and Analytics teams to translate technical capabilities into tangible user value. Their team operates with a foundation of high trust, significant ownership, and a preference for pragmatic, data-informed decision-making. About the Position They are seeking an experienced Full-Stack Developer to take on End-to-End ownership of product features. This role is about more than just writing code; it's about delivering tangible product outcomes. You will be instrumental in the entire development lifecycle, from designing robust database schemas and crafting clear APIs to building intuitive user interfaces and deploying reliable features to production, always grounding your technical decisions in the ultimate goal of the customer. Customer-Centric Product Development: Engage with customers to understand their needs, then design, prototype, and implement valuable, user-focused features for our Product. End-to-End Feature Ownership: Take full responsibility for features, spanning the entire lifecycle from initial data model and API design to web UI development and final production deployment. Data and System Architecture: Design and implement scalable data flows and schemas utilizing database technologies and event pipelines. Workflow Standardization and Evolution: Implement and continuously improve standardized product workflow, ensuring services communicate effectively by emitting and consuming domain events. Front-End and Geospatial Visualization: Develop accessible, responsive user interfaces with a focus on integrating complex geospatial visualizations, maps, and timelines. Technical Excellence and Reliability: Drive improvements in system reliability through automated testing, robust CI/CD pipelines, and enhanced observability practices. Infrastructure and Operations Contribution: Collaborate on infrastructure-as-code and deployment pipelines, contributing to sensible and sustainable operational practices. Adherence to the Team Principles: Apply core Team principles—including user focus, pragmatic planning, technical excellence, robust observability, and comprehensive documentation—to guide all decision-making. Total Ownership: Production‑ready, observable, and measurable is our “definition of ready.” User Focus: Optimize for an effective, efficient, and fulfilling journey. Planning & Pragmatism: Clear scope, iterative delivery, no fundamentalism. Technical Excellence: Tests, CI/CD, code reviews, atomic releases; code that tells a story. Observability & Reliability: We instrument first; we learn before users feel issues. Data‑Driven: Define success upfront; measure and adjust. Team Culture: Psychological safety, candid feedback, impeccable communication, continuous learning. Documentation: Clear, concise docs; no knowledge silos. Frontend Proficiency: Strong skills in React, TypeScript, modern state management, data handling patterns, and frontend testing best practices. Backend & Data: Expertise in Python for building web APIs and services, along with strong data modeling capabilities for PostgreSQL. Event-Driven Systems: Experience in designing, emitting, and handling domain events, with familiarity with event streaming platforms like Kafka. Quality & Testing: Proficient in backend testing tools and practices (pytest, coverage, mocks) and frontend testing methodologies. Observability: Ability to implement meaningful metrics, tracing, and structured logging (familiarity with tools like AWS Lambda Powertools and Sentry is a plus). DevOps & Infrastructure: Solid understanding of CI/CD fundamentals and comfort with Infrastructure-as-Code (specifically Terraform). Security: Foundational knowledge of security and authentication principles (e.g., Auth0/OIDC, JWT, managing permissions and entitlements). Geospatial Technologies: Experience with geospatial UI (deck.gl, Mapbox/MapLibre), STAC, or geospatial querying tools (pygeofilter). Business Integrations: Prior work with payments/billing systems (Stripe) or ERP synchronization (Acumatica). Data Optimization: Experience in data ingestion or optimizing time-series data. AWS at Scale: Advanced Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) experience managing AWS services at scale. Domain Expertise: Knowledge of Earth Observation workflows (including tasking, processing levels, and Quality Control). Problem‑First Mindset: You optimize for outcomes, not layers. You’re comfortable changing the database schema, the API, and the UI to ship the best solution. Architectural Fluidity: You can reason from the browser down to the data store, identifying bottlenecks and improving performance end‑to‑end. Collaboration & Stewardship: You communicate clearly, review with care, write docs as part of delivery, and own monitoring post‑release. Pragmatic Excellenc e: You value small, observable, reversible steps over big‑bang rewrites.

title: Pathway Platform Engineers
content: Summary We are seeking a senior Pathway Platform Engineer to own and evolve the CI/CD and environment lifecycle platform that enables safe, auditable application delivery across the enterprise. This role focuses on designing, building, and operating pipeline templates, infrastructure-as-code, policy-as-code governance, and software supply chain protections using GitHub and/or Azure DevOps, Terraform, and policy tooling. This is an opportunity to lead technical decisions, drive adoption of secure delivery practices, and integrate delivery platforms with enterprise operational processes such as ServiceNow and CAB automation. The role emphasizes automation, observability, reliability, and developer enablement to support large-scale, compliant releases. Responsibilities Own the CI/CD platform for application delivery: design reusable pipeline templates, secure defaults, quality gates, and developer enablement. Build and operate infrastructure pipelines for environment lifecycle management, including provisioning, promotion, drift detection, and controlled rollouts. Establish and maintain delivery governance with policy catalogs, change control, exception workflows, traceability, and audit evidence. Implement automated compliance and security checks in pipelines using policy-as-code and scanning, and continuously improve signal quality. Enable safe releases at scale through zero-downtime deployment patterns, progressive delivery, feature flag integration, and standardized rollback and verification practices. Automate change management integrations with ServiceNow and CAB workflows to reduce manual overhead while preserving controls and traceability. Operate and evolve build infrastructure (runners/agents and build pools): manage performance, reliability, hardening, patching, and cost awareness. Implement software supply chain protections including artifact provenance/attestation, signing/verification, and private artifact repository patterns. Integrate DevSecOps tooling into delivery flows and enable teams to remediate findings through reporting, triage, and automation. Build internal automation (apps/bots) that simplify developer workflows and enforce standards with minimal friction. Provide standardized automated testing capabilities (acceptance, performance, resiliency/chaos, operational acceptance tests) as pipeline stages and quality gates. Enable observability onboarding and standards with instrumentation guidance, dashboards-as-code, and alerting in partnership with solution teams. Partner with SRE and operations to improve reliability practices, availability policies, incident response, and on-call readiness. Requirements 6+ years designing, building, and operating CI/CD platforms for application delivery in enterprise environments (GitHub and/or Azure DevOps). 4+ years delivering infrastructure-as-code and environment lifecycle automation using Terraform, including reusable modules and promotion across environments. Proven track record implementing pipeline governance: policy-as-code, change control, exception handling, and producing audit-ready evidence. Hands-on experience with software supply chain controls, including artifact provenance/attestation, signing/verification, and private artifact repositories. Experience integrating delivery platforms with enterprise operational processes, including ServiceNow change automation and CAB integration. Strong automation and troubleshooting skills using Bash, PowerShell, and Python; able to independently diagnose pipeline, runner/agent, and environment failures. Demonstrated ability to lead technical decisions and drive adoption across teams through documentation, standards, and stakeholder alignment. Experience with GitHub Actions (reusable workflows, branch protections, required checks, CODEOWNERS) and runner/build pool operations, and/or Azure DevOps pipelines, agent pools, environments, and approvals. Experience implementing policy-as-code (Kyverno and/or Sentinel) and enforcement patterns within pipelines. Experience integrating DevSecOps tooling such as SonarQube and other scanning tools into delivery workflows. Experience with observability onboarding and tooling such as AppInsights and Dynatrace, including dashboards-as-code and alerting standards. Familiarity with reliability practices including availability policies, incident response, and on-call readiness (e.g., PagerDuty). Nice to Have Experience with CAB process automation. Experience building GitHub artifact attestation infrastructure. Experience managing Sentinel policy catalogs and change control. Experience implementing acceptance and performance test infrastructure. Experience building policy bots or internal automation (e.g., Probot-style apps). Experience with LaunchDarkly or Flagger for progressive delivery.

title: AI & Optimization Engineer
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for an AI & Optimization Engineer in India. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, optimization, and large-scale infrastructure operations within a globally distributed remote environment. In this role, you will help transform complex operational data into intelligent systems that drive automation, predictive insights, and efficiency improvements across high-performance environments. You will collaborate closely with engineering, data, and operational teams to design scalable AI solutions and optimize real-world systems using advanced machine learning and data modeling techniques. The position offers the chance to work on cutting-edge technologies involving time-series data, IoT-style telemetry, and production-grade AI deployment. Ideal for professionals passionate about innovation and applied AI, this role combines strategic thinking with hands-on technical execution in a fast-moving and highly collaborative setting. Define and execute AI and optimization strategies focused on improving operational efficiency and measurable business performance. Design and maintain scalable data models, schemas, and telemetry structures to support AI and machine learning initiatives. Develop, deploy, and optimize machine learning models for anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, automation, performance optimization, and operational forecasting. Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing systems, workflows, APIs, and production environments. Continuously monitor and improve model performance, reliability, explainability, and scalability in live operational settings. Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to translate operational challenges into data-driven solutions and actionable insights. Document architectures, modelling assumptions, and AI workflows clearly while promoting a data-driven and innovation-focused culture. Stay informed on emerging trends in AI, optimization, industrial analytics, and automation technologies. Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, or a related technical field. At least 3 years of experience in AI/ML engineering, applied optimization, data science, or related analytical roles. Strong expertise in Python and modern machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-Learn. Proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript within Node.js environments. Experience designing and managing large-scale, time-series–focused data architectures and pipelines. Solid understanding of optimization techniques, predictive modelling, anomaly detection, and industrial or telemetry-based AI systems. Familiarity with Docker and containerized deployment environments. Experience deploying, monitoring, and maintaining production AI systems, including handling model drift and changing operational conditions. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently in globally distributed remote teams. Excellent English communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders. Benefits: 100% remote work environment with global collaboration opportunities. Opportunity to work on innovative AI and optimization projects with real-world operational impact. Exposure to cutting-edge technologies in machine learning, automation, infrastructure, and distributed systems. Fast-paced and highly collaborative international team culture. Career growth opportunities within a rapidly evolving and innovation-driven industry. Flexible and autonomous work environment that encourages creativity and ownership. Work alongside highly skilled professionals in engineering, AI, and infrastructure operations.

title: AI Automation Specialist (Marketing background)
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for an AI Automation Specialist (Marketing background) in United Kingdom. This is an exciting opportunity for a technically skilled marketing professional who thrives at the intersection of AI, automation, and growth strategy. In this role, you will help build and optimize scalable AI-powered marketing systems that support multiple fast-growing brands across e-commerce, subscription, and food & beverage sectors. You’ll work in a highly collaborative and entrepreneurial remote environment where innovation and execution go hand in hand. The position is ideal for someone who enjoys transforming manual marketing operations into efficient automated workflows that drive measurable business outcomes. From SEO and email automation to analytics and AI-driven content systems, your work will directly impact operational performance and customer growth. This role offers significant autonomy, hands-on ownership, and the opportunity to shape modern AI-enabled marketing infrastructure from the ground up. Design, implement, and maintain AI-powered marketing automation workflows across multiple brands and channels. Build scalable systems for content generation, reporting, customer insights, email marketing, and operational efficiency using automation platforms and AI tools. Manage and optimize SEO initiatives including keyword research, content workflows, metadata improvements, internal linking, and competitor analysis. Support local SEO efforts by managing business listings, citations, FAQs, and location-based optimization strategies. Develop and improve lifecycle email marketing campaigns, including welcome flows, abandoned cart sequences, post-purchase communication, segmentation, and retention campaigns. Monitor automation systems, troubleshoot workflow issues, and continuously improve reliability, scalability, and performance. Analyze funnel performance, campaign metrics, and growth opportunities to provide actionable business insights and performance reporting. Collaborate closely with marketing and technical stakeholders to rapidly implement solutions and iterate based on evolving priorities. Requirements: 3–5+ years of experience in marketing automation, workflow optimization, or systems development within digital marketing environments. Hands-on expertise with automation platforms such as Make (Integromat), Zapier, n8n, or similar tools. Practical experience implementing AI-driven workflows using tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI platforms. Strong understanding of SEO, organic growth strategies, email marketing automation, and e-commerce marketing ecosystems. Familiarity with platforms and tools such as Ahrefs, Klaviyo, Google Analytics (GA4), Search Console, Shopify, and related marketing technologies. Ability to independently build, manage, troubleshoot, and optimize automation systems and API integrations. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capabilities, and an execution-focused mindset. Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in fast-moving remote teams. Experience with DTC, subscription-based businesses, startups, or lean operational environments is considered a strong advantage. Basic programming knowledge (such as Python) and experience building AI agents or advanced automation systems is a plus. Benefits: Fully remote work environment with flexible location setup. Part-time schedule (~20 hours per week) offering strong work-life flexibility. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI and automation initiatives across multiple high-growth brands. Exposure to diverse industries including e-commerce, subscriptions, and food & beverage ventures. Highly collaborative and entrepreneurial work culture focused on innovation and measurable impact. Competitive contractor compensation ranging from approximately $700–900 monthly depending on experience. Direct involvement in strategic growth and operational optimization projects with meaningful ownership.

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to the future of decentralized finance by building secure, scalable, and high-performance backend systems that power global digital asset solutions. In this role, you will work on mission-critical wallet infrastructure, helping create seamless and reliable experiences for users interacting with blockchain technologies worldwide. You will collaborate with highly skilled international teams in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment focused on scalability, security, and technical excellence. The position is ideal for engineers who enjoy solving complex backend challenges and building resilient systems capable of supporting rapidly growing platforms. You’ll work with modern technologies, distributed architectures, and cutting-edge financial applications while helping shape the evolution of digital finance. The environment values autonomy, continuous learning, collaboration, and a strong engineering mindset. Design, develop, and maintain robust backend services that support secure and scalable wallet infrastructure and digital asset operations. Build and optimize high-performance microservices capable of handling large-scale real-time transactions and platform growth. Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver innovative backend solutions aligned with evolving product and business requirements. Ensure the highest standards of platform security, implementing best practices to protect user assets, sensitive data, and system integrity. Contribute to architectural decisions and continuously improve system reliability, scalability, and maintainability. Work with databases and distributed systems to ensure efficient data storage, retrieval, and synchronization. Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve backend performance issues while proactively identifying opportunities for optimization. Stay current with emerging blockchain, peer-to-peer, and backend development technologies to drive innovation across the platform. Requirements: Strong professional experience with Node.js and JavaScript backend development. Solid understanding of microservices architecture and scalable distributed systems. Experience building and maintaining complex, high-availability backend platforms. Familiarity with peer-to-peer technologies and decentralized systems. Proficiency working with databases such as MySQL and MongoDB. Strong understanding of backend security principles and experience implementing secure coding practices. Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies, frameworks, and technical environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to performance, reliability, and scalability. Excellent communication and collaboration skills within remote and international teams. Experience working in Agile development environments is considered an asset. Interest or experience in blockchain, fintech, or digital asset ecosystems is highly valued. Benefits: Fully remote work environment with the flexibility to work from anywhere. Opportunity to contribute to innovative decentralized finance and blockchain technologies. Exposure to large-scale global platforms and cutting-edge backend systems. Collaborative international culture with access to highly skilled engineering teams. Fast-paced and innovation-focused environment that encourages ownership and technical growth. Opportunities for continuous learning, experimentation, and career advancement. Flexible work culture designed to support autonomy and productivity. Chance to work on impactful products shaping the future of digital finance and peer-to-peer technologies.

title: Backend Engineer, Core Sending
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Backend Engineer, Core Sending in the United States. This role sits at the heart of a high-scale email infrastructure platform, responsible for building and operating the systems that power millions of daily API requests and tens of millions of emails. You will work on deeply technical challenges involving distributed systems, high availability, and large-scale message delivery pipelines. The environment is fast-moving, remote-first, and highly autonomous, with a strong emphasis on ownership and execution. You will contribute to the architecture and evolution of core backend services, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability at global scale. This position blends backend engineering, infrastructure design, and systems thinking in a highly impactful domain. It is ideal for engineers who enjoy solving complex problems and building systems that developers rely on every day. Design, build, and evolve core backend systems responsible for sending and processing millions of transactional and marketing emails daily. Define and contribute to the architecture of highly scalable distributed systems supporting large-scale API traffic. Develop and maintain async messaging pipelines, including queues, streams, retries, idempotency, and dead-letter handling. Improve system reliability and high availability across distributed infrastructure environments. Scale and optimize databases such as Postgres and ClickHouse to ensure performance under heavy workloads. Enhance observability using monitoring and alerting tools such as Datadog to ensure system health and visibility. Support and improve disaster recovery strategies to ensure fast and reliable system recovery. Build and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as CDK and Terraform. Participate in on-call rotations for critical systems, ensuring stability and rapid incident response. Collaborate with engineering peers to improve developer experience and system robustness across the platform. Requirements: 8+ years of backend engineering experience, with strong focus on distributed systems and cloud infrastructure. Strong experience operating and scaling systems on AWS or similar cloud platforms. Deep understanding of event-driven architectures and messaging systems such as Kafka, SQS, SNS, or equivalent technologies. Strong proficiency in backend development using Typescript and/or Golang. Experience building and maintaining high-throughput, production-grade systems. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently on open-ended technical challenges. Experience working in high-scale environments with significant traffic or data processing requirements. Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal. Comfortable working in remote-first, asynchronous teams across Americas time zones. Low-ego, collaborative mindset with a strong bias toward execution and delivery. Interest in or willingness to learn about email infrastructure and delivery systems. Benefits: Fully remote-first work environment with flexible working hours. Competitive compensation package ranging from $150,000 to $170,000 USD depending on experience. Opportunity to work with a modern, developer-focused technology stack. High level of autonomy and ownership over systems and technical decisions. Collaborative, low-ego engineering culture focused on quality and craft. Exposure to large-scale distributed systems and high-impact technical challenges. Backing from leading investors and strong growth trajectory environment. Opportunities for team off-sites, conferences, and global meetups.

This is a high-impact enterprise sales role focused on driving new business and expanding strategic accounts within the payments and financial infrastructure space. You will own the full sales cycle in a fast-moving, remote-first environment, engaging directly with senior stakeholders such as founders, CEOs, CFOs, and CTOs. The role requires a consultative, solution-oriented mindset to understand complex client needs and translate them into tailored value propositions. You will be responsible for building and managing a strong pipeline through proactive outbound efforts and strategic relationship building. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will help shape sales strategy, refine messaging, and improve go-to-market execution. This position is ideal for a commercially driven professional who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys hunting for new opportunities, and is motivated by closing high-value enterprise deals. Own the full enterprise sales cycle from prospecting and lead generation through to negotiation and closing complex deals with senior decision-makers. Build and maintain a strong pipeline through outbound outreach, networking, and strategic partnerships to consistently deliver revenue growth. Develop tailored, consultative sales strategies to address client challenges and articulate the value of a unified payments and financial operations platform. Collaborate closely with Sales Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams to ensure seamless delivery and continuous feedback loops. Contribute to the refinement of sales playbooks, processes, and Ideal Customer Profile definition based on market insights and client interactions. Accurately forecast sales performance and maintain disciplined CRM management and reporting. Stay informed on industry trends and payment innovations to strengthen client conversations and positioning. Requirements: Proven experience in enterprise or strategic B2B sales, ideally within fintech, payments, SaaS, or complex technology environments. Strong track record of consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets in a high-performance sales environment. Ability to manage long, complex sales cycles involving multiple senior stakeholders and technical evaluations. Excellent consultative selling, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Highly proactive, self-driven, and comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous, and remote-first settings. Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate technical solutions into business value. Curiosity, resilience, and a continuous learning mindset with a strong bias toward action. Benefits: Fully remote and globally distributed work environment Competitive share options Uncapped holiday allowance (minimum 25 days) Co-working space access Annual company retreats and workation opportunities High-quality equipment provided for your role Home office setup allowance (£500) Generous learning and development budget Private medical insurance Additional location-dependent perks and benefits

title: Business Development Manager - Power Geotech Construction (PDE)
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Business Development Manager - Power Geotech Construction (PDE) in United States. This is a high-impact, field-driven business development role focused on driving growth across geotechnical and geohazard mitigation projects within the energy and heavy civil infrastructure sectors. You will operate at the intersection of technical engineering and strategic sales, identifying high-value opportunities and converting them into long-term client partnerships. The role requires a strong ability to engage with engineers, consultants, and infrastructure stakeholders while translating complex geotechnical challenges into practical, design-build solutions. You will be responsible for owning the full pursuit lifecycle, from opportunity identification to proposal development and deal closure. Working closely with internal engineering, estimating, and operations teams, you will help shape competitive, value-driven project strategies. This position is ideal for a technically grounded, relationship-oriented professional who thrives in fast-paced, field-based environments. Identify and develop new business opportunities across energy, power, oil & gas, renewable energy, and heavy civil infrastructure markets within assigned territories. Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders including clients, consultants, and industry influencers. Lead end-to-end pursuit management including opportunity qualification, solution development, proposal creation, and bid strategy execution. Collaborate with engineering, estimating, and operations teams to design competitive design-build solutions aligned with client needs. Represent the organization at industry events, conferences, and trade associations to expand market presence and generate leads. Maintain structured account plans and pipeline activity using CRM tools to track engagement and performance. Provide market intelligence, competitive insights, and regional feedback to support broader sales and engineering strategy. Ensure client satisfaction through responsive communication, proactive follow-up, and long-term relationship management. Requirements: 8–10+ years of experience in technical sales, business development, or client-facing engineering roles. Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related technical field required. Strong experience in geotechnical, energy, or heavy civil infrastructure sectors strongly preferred. Professional Engineer (PE) license is an advantage. Proven ability to manage complex, solution-oriented sales cycles in technical environments. Strong understanding of construction practices, design-build models, and infrastructure project delivery. Experience using CRM systems such as Salesforce; familiarity with estimating tools is a plus. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders. Strong networking capability within regional construction, engineering, and energy markets. Willingness to travel regularly within assigned territory (CA, CO, LA, OR, TX, WA preferred). Self-driven, resilient, and comfortable operating in fast-paced, field-based environments. Benefits: Competitive on-target earnings (OTE) between $150,000 – $175,000 USD annually. Base salary range of $95,000 – $105,000 USD depending on experience and location. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans. Mental health support and employee wellness programs. 401(k) retirement plan with company match. Paid parental leave. Flexible paid time off in addition to 7 company-observed holidays. Opportunity to work on critical infrastructure and geohazard mitigation projects with national impact. Strong field-based autonomy with high visibility across key accounts and markets.

content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Content Designer Senior (AI) in Brazil. This is an exciting opportunity for a senior content and conversational design professional passionate about creating impactful AI-driven user experiences. In this role, you will shape and optimize conversational journeys for a financial assistant platform used daily by thousands of customers, transforming interactions into intuitive, efficient, and highly engaging experiences. You will combine UX writing, conversational AI strategy, and data analysis to continuously improve performance metrics and user satisfaction. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Marketing teams, you will help evolve AI communication into a scalable and business-oriented product experience. This role is ideal for someone who sees conversation design as both a creative and analytical discipline, driven by experimentation, user empathy, and measurable results. Design and optimize conversational experiences focused on reducing friction and improving user outcomes. Define and evolve the AI assistant’s tone of voice, ensuring clarity, consistency, accessibility, and natural interactions. Structure and improve conversational flows with a strong focus on resolution efficiency and conversion performance. Analyze real user conversations to identify pain points, ambiguities, drop-off patterns, and optimization opportunities. Monitor key metrics such as success rates, fallback occurrences, resolution times, and customer satisfaction indicators. Translate data insights into actionable improvements for conversational experiences and business performance. Conduct A/B testing for messages, interaction flows, engagement strategies, and recovery approaches. Collaborate with Product, Data, Engineering, and Marketing teams to align conversational improvements with business goals. Support initiatives focused on activation, retention, and product adoption through conversational experiences. Promote UX writing best practices and share knowledge across multidisciplinary teams. Requirements: Proven experience as a UX Writer, Content Designer, or similar role, with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to simplify complex experiences. Experience designing conversational AI solutions and chatbot interactions. Strong analytical mindset combined with deep sensitivity to user experience and communication clarity. Experience working with hypothesis-driven design and experimentation methodologies. Ability to connect UX decisions with business metrics and measurable outcomes. Strong attention to detail, especially regarding language consistency and AI behavior. Ownership mindset and commitment to continuous improvement. Deep understanding of UX principles and design thinking methodologies. Excellent writing and communication skills with the ability to adapt language for different audiences and contexts. Ability to work effectively in agile, collaborative, and results-oriented environments. Nice to have: experience with Design Systems and content governance practices. Nice to have: knowledge of prompt engineering, LLM limitations, and RAG concepts. Nice to have: experience in fintech or financial services environments. Nice to have: experience conducting A/B testing and optimizing digital journeys. Nice to have: familiarity with accessibility guidelines such as WCAG. Nice to have: experience participating in user research activities including usability testing and interviews. Nice to have: familiarity with analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, Databricks, or SQL. Benefits: Full-time CLT employment contract. This is a high-impact opportunity to help build and scale the customer marketing function within a fast-growing, product-led B2B SaaS environment at the forefront of AI-powered workflow orchestration. In this role, you will shape how customer stories, advocacy, and proof are transformed into strategic growth assets that support pipeline generation, enterprise trust, and product adoption. You will work cross-functionally across product marketing, sales, customer success, and demand generation to turn real customer success into compelling narratives and scalable programs. The position offers a rare chance to build a function almost from scratch, defining the systems, processes, and strategy that will elevate customer marketing into a core go-to-market driver. Operating in a highly collaborative, remote-first, and builder-driven culture, you will have strong ownership and visibility across the organization. This role is ideal for someone who combines storytelling excellence with strategic thinking and enjoys turning customer insight into measurable business impact. Own and define the end-to-end customer marketing strategy, building a scalable foundation for advocacy, storytelling, and customer proof programs Develop structured systems to identify, prioritize, and source high-impact customer stories across industries, use cases, and product areas Create and maintain customer-facing assets such as case studies, testimonials, success narratives, reference materials, and co-marketing content Collaborate closely with Product Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, Partnerships, Content, and Demand Generation teams to align messaging and leverage customer insights Translate post-sale customer experiences into compelling assets that support sales conversations, enterprise deals, and marketing campaigns Enable sales teams with effective customer proof materials to strengthen outbound efforts and improve conversion in complex deal cycles Build repeatable workflows, tools, and processes to scale customer marketing operations over time Measure performance of customer marketing initiatives and continuously optimize based on business and revenue impact Requirements: Senior-level experience in Customer Marketing, Product Marketing, Customer Advocacy, or content-driven storytelling within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment Proven ability to build structured programs and operating models in early-stage or evolving marketing functions Strong track record of transforming customer insights into high-impact marketing and sales enablement assets Experience working cross-functionally and influencing senior stakeholders in a fast-paced organization without direct authority Excellent storytelling, editorial, and communication skills with a strong understanding of commercially valuable narratives Ability to balance strategic thinking organizations is considered an advantage Benefits: Competitive compensation package with equity opportunities Fully remote-first work environment across Europe and beyond Generous vacation allowance title: Customer Service & Benefits Advisor
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Customer Service & Benefits Advisor in Canada. This remote role focuses on building and maintaining long-term relationships with clients through virtual, face-to-face interactions. You will support individuals and families by presenting life, accident, and supplemental health benefit solutions tailored to their needs. The position is centered on delivering a personalized and trustworthy customer experience via Zoom meetings from the comfort of your home. It offers the opportunity to work with a mission-driven environment that values stability, service, and client protection. You will play a key role in helping members understand and access essential coverage options. This is a performance-oriented role designed for motivated individuals who enjoy communication, autonomy, and relationship-building. It is fully remote, offering flexibility and the ability to manage your own schedule effectively. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining strong client relationships while delivering tailored benefit solutions through virtual consultations. Conduct virtual meetings with clients to assess needs and present appropriate coverage options Build long-term relationships with members of unions, associations, and partner groups Clearly explain life, accident, and supplemental health products in an accessible way Maintain accurate records of client interactions and follow-ups Manage your schedule effectively to meet activity and performance expectations Collaborate with internal teams to ensure a smooth client experience from presentation to enrollment Requirements: The ideal candidate is a strong communicator with a proactive mindset and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. Excellent verbal and written communication skills Basic computer literacy and comfort with virtual communication tools (e.g., Zoom) Strong work ethic with consistent self-motivation Outgoing, energetic, and relationship-oriented personality Effective time management and organizational skills Previous experience in customer service, sales, or leadership is an asset Benefits: This position offers a flexible, remote-first structure with performance-based earning potential and long-term financial incentives. 100% remote work from home flexibility Weekly pay based on performance and schedule consistency Bonus structures and commission-based earning opportunities Health insurance reimbursement options Life insurance coverage Retirement plan participation Long-term renewal income opportunities Flexible scheduling to support work-life balance.

title: Customer Service Administrator
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Customer Service Administrator in India. This role is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented and customer-focused professional who enjoys supporting operational processes in a fast-paced remote environment. You will play a key role in coordinating property compliance activities by managing communication between tenants, landlords, and service providers while ensuring appointments are scheduled efficiently and accurately. The position combines customer service, administrative coordination, and scheduling responsibilities, making it ideal for someone who thrives in organized and communication-driven roles. You will contribute directly to maintaining high service standards and supporting smooth operational workflows during critical compliance periods. Working alongside an established international team, you will gain exposure to large-scale operations and ongoing growth opportunities. This remote position offers flexibility, professional development, and the chance to build long-term experience in customer support and business operations. Coordinate health and safety inspection appointments by communicating with tenants, landlords, and service providers through phone and online systems. Make outbound calls to schedule, confirm, and reschedule inspection appointments while ensuring professional and courteous customer interactions. Respond to tenant inquiries and concerns related to property inspections, compliance schedules, and appointment arrangements. Maintain accurate records of communications, bookings, confirmations, and follow-up actions within internal systems. Monitor missed appointments and proactively manage rescheduling processes to ensure operational continuity. Support business operations during peak compliance periods by handling increased scheduling and communication volumes efficiently. Collaborate with internal teams and stakeholders to ensure smooth coordination across a large portfolio of client relationships. Deliver high-quality administrative and customer service support while meeting agreed timelines and operational standards. Requirements: Previous experience in customer service, appointment scheduling, administrative support, or call-handling roles. Excellent verbal communication skills with a professional and customer-oriented phone manner. Strong organizational and multitasking abilities with attention to detail and accuracy in record management. Ability to handle sensitive or challenging conversations professionally, particularly regarding property access and compliance matters. Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while managing schedules and deadlines effectively. Familiarity with online booking tools, administrative systems, and remote communication platforms. Patient, diplomatic, and solution-oriented mindset when coordinating between multiple parties and stakeholders. Understanding of UK property compliance processes, rental regulations, or tenant rights is considered an advantage. Professional English communication skills with a neutral and clear speaking style preferred. Availability to work full-time hours aligned with UK business operations (Monday to Friday, 9AM–6PM UK time). Benefits: Fully remote work opportunity with flexible home-based setup. Competitive compensation with reliable weekly payments. Access to free training, professional development, and upskilling opportunities. Exposure to international clients and global business operations. Supportive and collaborative remote community environment. Continuous guidance and operational support throughout assignments. Opportunity to work on diverse projects and explore additional remote roles over time. Career growth potential as operations and service offerings continue to expand.

title: Customer Success Manager
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Customer Success Manager in Brazil. This role sits at the heart of the customer experience, focusing on building strong, trusted relationships with a diverse portfolio of clients across the Americas. You will ensure customers successfully adopt and maximize value from a global SaaS platform designed to simplify international hiring, payroll, and workforce management. Operating in a fully remote, fast-paced, and collaborative environment, you will act as a strategic partner to your accounts, driving engagement, retention, and long-term satisfaction. The position requires a proactive mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to navigate complex customer needs across multiple stakeholders. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Sales, Support, and Finance to resolve issues and improve the customer journey. This is a high-impact role where your insights and actions directly influence customer success and business growth. Manage and grow relationships with a portfolio of customers, ensuring strong engagement, satisfaction, and long-term retention across the customer lifecycle. Monitor customer health, proactively address risks, and resolve issues or escalations in collaboration with internal teams. Lead onboarding, product demos, enablement sessions, and success planning to drive product adoption and value realization. Act as the main point of contact for internal stakeholders, coordinating requests from Sales, Support, Product, and other teams. Collaborate on churn prevention strategies, including working with Sales and Finance teams on retention and payment-related matters. Use data-driven insights to identify customer needs, surface trends, and advocate for improvements in products and processes. Requirements: Minimum 2 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or quota-carrying roles within SaaS or technology environments. Proven ability to manage multiple customer relationships while maintaining high levels of satisfaction and retention. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and influence stakeholders at all levels. Analytical mindset with experience using data to identify risks, opportunities, and customer behavior trends. Comfortable working cross-functionally in fast-paced, distributed environments with shifting priorities. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a proactive, problem-solving attitude. Fluency in English, both written and verbal, is required. Experience with tools such as Zendesk, Asana, Notion, or Slack is a plus. Benefits: Fully remote work model with the flexibility to work from anywhere within the supported region. Generous paid time off, including up to 40 days annually depending on location. Flexible parental leave with extended job protection. Monthly wellbeing allowance to support physical and mental health. Home office stipend for equipment and workspace setup. Access to mental health and wellness support services. Opportunities for learning, development, and professional growth. Inclusive, global, and diverse work environment with a strong remote-first culture.

content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Customer Success Manager in Brazil. This role focuses on managing and growing a large portfolio of SMB and mid-market customers through scalable, data-driven success strategies. You will be responsible for ensuring customers achieve value quickly and continuously throughout their lifecycle, using automation, structured programs, and proactive engagement rather than purely manual interactions. The position plays a key role in driving adoption, retention, and expansion by identifying risks early and acting on usage signals and customer health indicators. You will collaborate closely with onboarding, product, and cross-functional teams to ensure smooth customer journeys and consistent value delivery. This is a highly operational and strategic role in a fast-paced SaaS environment where efficiency, scalability, and customer outcomes are at the center of success. It is ideal for someone who enjoys building systems, working with data, and improving processes to support growth at scale. Manage a high-volume portfolio of SMB and mid-market accounts, ensuring engagement and retention at scale. Drive customer adoption and success through automated touchpoints, scalable programs, and data-driven outreach. Prioritize accounts based on health scores, risk levels, and expansion opportunities. Ensure successful onboarding and early time-to-value for new customers. Monitor usage and proactively intervene when accounts show signs of inactivity or churn risk. Design and implement scalable customer success programs, including email campaigns, webinars, and in-app engagement flows. Build and optimize repeatable playbooks for onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion. Collaborate with onboarding and cross-functional teams to ensure seamless customer handoffs and experience continuity. Identify at-risk accounts early using health and behavioral signals, taking corrective action to reduce churn. Support renewals and expansion through ongoing engagement and value reinforcement. Track and analyze key KPIs such as adoption, retention, churn risk, and customer engagement. Share insights and feedback with internal teams to improve product, processes, and customer experience. Requirements 2–4 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or similar customer-facing roles in SaaS or B2B environments. Experience managing a high-volume book of business with multiple accounts simultaneously. Strong operational and analytical mindset with ability to work with data and identify trends. Familiarity with CS and CRM tools such as Vitally, Intercom, HubSpot, or Salesforce. Experience building or optimizing customer success playbooks, workflows, or automation strategies. Strong communication, organizational, and relationship management skills. Ability to balance speed, scalability, and quality in a fast-paced environment. Comfortable working independently while also collaborating in cross-functional teams. Strong multitasking ability and results-oriented mindset. Fluent English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus. Benefits Competitive compensation aligned with experience and performance. Remote-first work environment with flexibility. Career growth opportunities in a fast-scaling global organization. Structured training programs and ongoing performance feedback. Referral bonuses and incentive programs. Product discounts for personal and business use. Multicultural and collaborative international team. Dynamic and fast-paced work environment with strong leadership support. Opportunities for professional development and internal advancement.

title: Data Analyst, Employee Service Center
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Data Analyst, Employee Service Center in United States. This role sits at the heart of employee experience operations, transforming complex HR and service delivery data into actionable insights that drive better support outcomes, operational efficiency, and strategic decision-making. You will work across HR systems and service platforms to analyze performance trends, uncover bottlenecks, and improve the quality and speed of employee services. Acting as a key analytical partner to Employee Service & Operations leaders, you will design dashboards, monitor core metrics, and provide the insights needed to optimize staffing, workflows, and service delivery models. The environment is highly collaborative and data-driven, with strong exposure to cross-functional HR teams and enterprise programs. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys deep analytical work combined with storytelling and operational impact. Your work will directly influence how employees experience support services across the organization. Own and maintain Employee Service Center reporting cadences, including dashboards and recurring reports that translate operational data into insights for leadership reviews and business decision-making. Monitor and analyze key service metrics such as SLA adherence, resolution time, backlog, CSAT, and case volume to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities. Conduct deep-dive analysis of Workday transactions and HR Service Delivery workflows to identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and root causes impacting service performance. Support capacity and workforce planning by developing data models and dashboards that inform staffing needs and operational scaling decisions. Investigate recurring issues, escalations, and process gaps, quantifying impact and recommending data-driven improvements and workflow optimizations. Partner with HR, COEs, IT, Payroll, and other stakeholders to support cyclical HR programs, organizational changes, and enterprise initiatives with accurate reporting and insights. Ensure data quality and integrity by auditing HR transactions, identifying discrepancies, and recommending process or system improvements. Communicate insights through clear visuals and narratives tailored to both technical and non-technical audiences to support decision-making and prioritization. Requirements: 3–5 years of experience in HR analytics, HR operations, workforce management, shared services, or similar data-focused roles. Strong experience working with HR systems such as Workday and ticketing/workflow platforms like ServiceNow or equivalent tools. Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools such as Excel, BI dashboards, and ideally SQL or similar querying languages. Strong analytical mindset with experience identifying root causes, trends, and operational inefficiencies from large datasets. Ability to build dashboards and reports and translate complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations. Strong communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience working in HR service delivery or employee operations environments is highly preferred. Strong attention to detail, data integrity mindset, and commitment to confidentiality when handling sensitive employee information. Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced environment. Benefits: Competitive salary range between $79,000 and $132,800 depending on location, experience, and qualifications. Eligibility for equity awards based on performance, experience, and role level. Fully remote work flexibility across most U.S. locations. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage. Paid time off, holidays, and employee wellness programs. Retirement savings plan with company support. Opportunities to work on high-impact HR analytics and enterprise transformation initiatives. Inclusive and collaborative culture focused on innovation, growth, and employee development.

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of AI-powered healthcare data platforms within a highly collaborative and innovation-driven environment. In this role, you will lead the design and evolution of enterprise-scale AI and data architecture solutions that transform complex structured and unstructured data into trusted, reusable assets. You’ll work at the intersection of data engineering, AI enablement, governance, and cloud infrastructure, helping accelerate intelligent decision-making and scalable AI adoption. The position offers significant ownership over platform architecture, semantic data design, retrieval systems, and operational excellence. You will partner cross-functionally with engineering, product, AI, compliance, and business stakeholders to build production-grade solutions that support long-term innovation. Establish operational standards for monitoring, CI/CD, testing, observability, reliability, and platform performance optimization. Implement governance, security, and compliance controls including RBAC/ABAC, audit logging, PII handling, and secure AI access patterns. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical roadmaps, architectural decisions, and AI platform capabilities with business goals. Mentor engineering teams through technical leadership, architecture reviews, documentation, and engineering best practices. Drive platform scalability, reliability, cost optimization, and retrieval performance improvements over time. Support the long-term evolution of the platform and contribute to future team leadership and organizational growth. Expert-level SQL skills and strong proficiency in Python, Scala, or Java. This leadership role offers the opportunity to shape national market access strategy for a growing pharmaceutical portfolio within a highly specialized healthcare environment. The position is focused on driving profitable payer access, optimizing formulary placement, and strengthening relationships across PBMs, government programs, and commercial health plans. Working cross-functionally with sales, marketing, finance, and field access teams, you will help influence commercial performance while improving patient access to innovative therapies. This is an ideal opportunity for a strategic and collaborative leader who thrives in complex market access environments and enjoys building high-performing teams. The role combines executive-level strategy with hands-on account leadership, contract negotiation, and payer engagement. Operating within a remote-first structure, you will have national visibility and meaningful influence on long-term business growth. Lead the national payer access and reimbursement strategy across commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, PBM, and federal healthcare channels to ensure optimal formulary positioning and profitable access for the product portfolio. Oversee and mentor a team of National Account Managers, providing leadership, coaching, training support, and strategic direction to strengthen payer engagement and execution. Develop and implement customer-specific contracting and reimbursement strategies aligned with pricing policies, GTN objectives, and long-term commercial goals. Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key payer stakeholders, including Pharmacy Directors, Medical Directors, PBMs, GPOs, and government healthcare organizations. Collaborate closely with field sales, market access, marketing, finance, and commercial operations teams to support pull-through initiatives, reimbursement education, and market expansion efforts. Analyze payer trends, contract performance, market dynamics, and healthcare policy developments to identify growth opportunities and improve market positioning. Lead forecasting discussions, financial analyses, contract lifecycle management, and leadership communications related to payer access performance and strategic initiatives. Ensure all activities are conducted in compliance with healthcare regulations, internal policies, and industry standards. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree required; advanced education in business, healthcare, or related fields is a plus. 8+ years of pharmaceutical or biotech experience within managed markets, payer strategy, or PBM environments, including at least 3 years leading national account teams. Strong understanding of US healthcare market dynamics, payer economics, formulary decision-making, reimbursement processes, and specialty pharmacy access models. Proven experience negotiating complex payer contracts and developing strategic market access initiatives within specialty or orphan drug environments. Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and collaborate effectively across matrixed commercial and medical organizations. Established relationships with national and regional payer organizations, PBMs, government healthcare channels, and key reimbursement decision-makers. Strong analytical, financial, and strategic thinking capabilities, with experience managing forecasting, contract performance, and business case development. Excellent communication, leadership, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment. Willingness to travel nationally approximately 30% of the time. Benefits: Competitive base salary ranging from $220,000 to $250,000 annually Performance-based bonus opportunities Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance Life and disability coverage 401(k) savings plan Professional development and career growth opportunities Remote work flexibility Collaborative and patient-focused work culture Diverse and inclusive workplace environment.

This leadership role is responsible for defining and scaling the operating system that enables Product and Engineering teams to execute with clarity, alignment, and predictable delivery. The Director of Product Operations & Planning serves as the critical bridge between strategy and execution, translating company priorities into structured planning frameworks, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes. This position plays a central role in improving how work is prioritized, tracked, and delivered across a complex, fast-moving SaaS organization. It requires strong operational rigor, cross-functional influence, and the ability to bring structure to ambiguity in a high-growth environment. The role also drives continuous improvement in planning processes, execution visibility, and organizational efficiency. It is ideal for a systems-oriented leader who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and business strategy. Define, implement, and continuously evolve the Product & Engineering operating model, including planning cycles, governance frameworks, and execution cadences. Lead annual and quarterly planning processes (including OKRs), ensuring alignment from company strategy to team-level execution. Establish roadmap governance structures that drive clarity, prioritization discipline, and transparent decision-making across leadership teams. Build and maintain end-to-end portfolio visibility across initiatives, dependencies, capacity, and resource allocation. Develop prioritization frameworks that balance strategic value, customer impact, and operational constraints. Implement systems and metrics to improve delivery predictability, cycle time, throughput, and overall execution quality. Drive cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, Finance, and Commercial teams to ensure consistent prioritization and trade-off decisions. Identify inefficiencies and operational risks, leading continuous improvement initiatives across planning and execution workflows. Support AI-enabled operational transformation by leveraging tools to improve forecasting, planning, and workflow automation. Requirements: 10+ years of experience in Product Operations, Program Management, Product Management, or related roles within SaaS or technology environments. Proven experience building and scaling product operating models, planning systems, or portfolio management frameworks. Strong track record of leading annual and quarterly planning processes (e.g., OKRs) across cross-functional organizations. Experience defining and operationalizing performance metrics that improve delivery outcomes and organizational transparency. Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment on priorities and trade-offs. Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into scalable processes, systems, and measurable operational improvements. Strong business and financial acumen, including understanding of resource allocation and investment trade-offs. Experience working in high-growth or scaling technology companies is preferred. Executive communication skills with the ability to present complex ideas clearly to leadership audiences. Familiarity with AI tools and their application in operational workflows is a plus. Benefits: Competitive annual salary range of $180,000 – $245,000. Eligibility for performance-based bonus (up to 15% of base salary). Comprehensive healthcare coverage including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance. 401(k) plan with company match and financial wellness benefits. Generous paid time off, holidays, wellness days, and paid volunteer time. Remote-first work environment across the United States. Career development opportunities, internal mobility, and structured learning programs. Tuition assistance and professional development support. Wellness resources including mental health support and employee assistance programs. Inclusive, collaborative culture focused on trust, innovation, and continuous improvement.

title: Director, Program Design
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Director, Program Design in Canada. This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for a strategic program design professional passionate about building equitable, community-centered solutions. In this role, you will shape and lead the development of innovative programs that support access to energy, housing, climate, and transportation initiatives across diverse communities. You’ll work at the intersection of policy, funding, operations, and social impact, translating complex RFPs and partnership opportunities into scalable, actionable program strategies. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, government stakeholders, utilities, and community organizations, you will guide proposal development from concept to execution while ensuring alignment with long-term organizational goals. The position combines strategic thinking, relationship management, and hands-on project leadership in a flexible, mission-driven environment. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, values collaboration, and is motivated by creating meaningful, measurable impact. Lead the assessment, prioritization, and management of funding opportunities, RFPs, and partnership proposals across multiple program areas. Design high-impact, equity-centered programs by developing needs assessments, logic models, customer journey maps, implementation frameworks, and theories of change. Translate funding requirements, policy objectives, and stakeholder needs into scalable program strategies and operational plans. Apply community-centered and equity-focused design principles, including co-design methods, stakeholder engagement, and anti-oppressive frameworks. Define program delivery models, implementation workflows, resource allocation plans, and risk mitigation strategies. Develop budgets, pricing models, KPI frameworks, evaluation strategies, and reporting structures in collaboration with finance and program teams. Serve as the primary liaison with funders and partners throughout the proposal and onboarding process. Act as proposal project manager, coordinating timelines, deliverables, communications, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure successful submissions and smooth program handoffs. Maintain accurate forecasting, reporting, and pipeline visibility through CRM systems and internal processes. Requirements: 5–10+ years of experience in program design, strategy, proposal management, or related leadership roles. Proven experience leading RFP responses and managing complex proposal development processes from evaluation through submission. Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and competing priorities. Demonstrated experience working with governments, utilities, nonprofits, regulated industries, or mission-driven organizations. Expertise in stakeholder engagement, cross-functional collaboration, and managing multiple internal and external partners. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong organizational and project management abilities. Experience designing customer-centered or community-based programs, including implementation planning and evaluation frameworks. Collaborative, adaptable, and hands-on leadership style with strong attention to quality and outcomes. Familiarity with energy efficiency, clean energy, climate action, housing, or social justice initiatives is considered an asset. Ability to work effectively in a remote environment with availability aligned to PST or MST working hours preferred. Benefits: Competitive salary ranging from $120,000 to $150,000 annually. Fully remote and flexible work environment across Canada and the U.S. Comprehensive health and wellness benefits package. Unlimited vacation policy promoting work-life balance and flexibility. Opportunity to contribute to meaningful, equity-focused community initiatives. Collaborative and mission-driven workplace culture. Inclusive environment that values diversity, lived experiences, and continuous learning. Opportunities for professional growth, leadership development, and cross-functional collaboration.

title: Director, Provider Operations
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Director, Provider Operations in the United States. This is a strategic leadership opportunity for an experienced healthcare operations professional passionate about transforming provider experiences and scaling innovative care delivery models. In this role, you will oversee the full provider lifecycle, building operational systems and workforce strategies that enable clinicians to deliver high-quality virtual care efficiently and effectively. You will collaborate cross-functionally with clinical, product, engineering, recruiting, and finance teams to optimize provider engagement, performance, and operational scalability. The position combines strategic planning with hands-on operational leadership in a fast-growing, mission-driven healthcare environment focused on improving chronic disease management and patient outcomes. Ideal candidates are analytical, people-focused leaders who thrive in high-growth settings and enjoy designing scalable systems that support both business success and exceptional care delivery. This role offers the opportunity to shape a critical operational function at the center of an innovative digital health organization Own and optimize the full provider lifecycle across W2 and 1099 networks, including hiring, onboarding, engagement, performance management, retention, and offboarding. Develop and execute provider workforce strategies aligned with business growth, operational demand, licensing requirements, and market expansion goals. Build scalable provider operations systems, workflows, and infrastructure to support efficient and high-quality virtual care delivery. Establish and monitor provider performance metrics related to quality of care, productivity, utilization, satisfaction, engagement, and retention. Collaborate with Clinical Operations and Quality teams to support provider coaching, feedback processes, and continuous performance improvement initiatives. Partner with Recruiting teams to strengthen provider hiring pipelines, improve time-to-fill metrics, and optimize workforce mix strategies across clinician types and employment models. Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to improve provider-facing tools, reduce operational friction, and enhance overall provider experience. Lead provider compensation, incentive structures, and payment operations, ensuring accuracy, transparency, scalability, and alignment with organizational goals. Analyze provider utilization, workforce economics, and operational efficiency to support sustainable and cost-effective growth. Drive cross-functional initiatives that improve operational scalability, provider satisfaction, and long-term organizational performance. Requirements: Minimum of 10 years of experience in healthcare operations, provider operations, workforce management, or related healthcare leadership functions. At least 5 years of leadership experience managing provider organizations, clinical operations, or large-scale healthcare teams. Proven success building and scaling provider operations in fast-growing or high-growth healthcare environments. Strong analytical, operational, and strategic thinking skills with experience managing provider capacity, utilization, productivity, and workforce economics. Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Recruiting, Finance, and Clinical teams. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across diverse teams and organizational levels. Strong understanding of provider engagement, operational workflows, and healthcare delivery models. Experience developing scalable operational systems and process improvements within healthcare environments. Familiarity with telehealth, digital health, virtual care, or value-based care models is strongly preferred. Experience working directly with clinicians and managing both W2 and 1099 workforce structures is highly desirable. Ability to thrive in fast-paced, mission-driven, and highly collaborative startup or growth-stage environments. Benefits: Competitive compensation package including salary and equity opportunities. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage. Flexible paid time off policies. Remote and work-from-home flexibility. Professional development budget and continuing education support. Opportunity to shape and lead a critical operational function within a high-growth healthcare organization. Collaborative and mission-driven work environment focused on improving healthcare accessibility and patient outcomes. Exposure to innovative digital health technologies and AI-enabled care delivery models. Career growth opportunities within a rapidly expanding organization. Internationally distributed and collaborative team culture with opportunities to contribute across global teams.

title: Director, Regulatory Project Management
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Director, Regulatory Project Management in United States. In this role, you will help drive global regulatory strategies into actionable submission plans across a diverse portfolio of development-stage and marketed products. Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities with a focus on process optimization and operational excellence. title: Director, Revenue Operations & Strategy
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Director, Revenue Operations & Strategy in United States. This is a strategic leadership opportunity for a commercially minded operator who thrives at the intersection of revenue growth, pricing strategy, and operational excellence. In this role, you will shape and optimize commercial deal structures, pricing models, and revenue operations processes that directly influence business growth and scalability. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, and Operations teams to improve deal velocity, maximize revenue outcomes, and establish scalable commercial frameworks.
