Strong expertise in B2B or B2B2C technology environments, preferably within healthcare, SaaS, or AI-driven organizations. Deep understanding of software pricing strategies, promotions, deal structures, and commercial negotiations. Proven ability to design creative solutions that help accelerate or unblock complex deals. Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving Sales, Legal, Finance, Customer Success, and Enablement teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with a highly strategic and operational mindset. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complex business concepts. Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools into daily workflows to improve productivity and business outcomes. Ability to travel up to 20% as needed. Benefits: Competitive base salary ranging from $200,000 to $220,000 annually Performance-based bonus opportunities and additional compensation components Fully remote work flexibility within the United States Opportunity to work in a high-growth, mission-driven AI and healthcare environment Collaborative and inclusive company culture focused on innovation and impact Career growth opportunities within a rapidly scaling organization Exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies and data-driven commercial strategies Supportive and team-oriented work environment emphasizing creativity and continuous improvement.

title: Director, Revenue Systems Strategy
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Director, Revenue Systems Strategy in United Kingdom. This role sits at the core of a rapidly scaling global revenue organization, where you will shape the technical backbone that powers go-to-market performance. You will lead the strategy, architecture, and evolution of the entire revenue systems ecosystem, enabling sales, marketing, and revenue operations teams to operate with speed, precision, and scalability. Working in a highly dynamic, global, and AI-forward environment, you will design and optimize systems that directly influence pipeline generation, conversion, and revenue growth. You will partner closely with senior GTM leadership to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions across complex platforms. The role blends strategic leadership, systems thinking, and hands-on technical oversight across a modern RevOps tech stack. This is a high-impact position where your work directly shapes how revenue is generated and scaled across a global organization. Own and evolve the overall revenue systems architecture aligned with go-to-market strategy, ensuring scalability, reliability, and data integrity across all revenue operations platforms. Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of end-to-end revenue processes, workflows, and automation across the full GTM lifecycle. Manage and enhance the core revenue tech stack (including Salesforce and adjacent tools), ensuring seamless integration, adoption, and performance. Translate business requirements into structured technical solutions, ensuring alignment between sales, marketing, and revenue operations stakeholders. Drive change management for system implementations and upgrades while fostering a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement. Establish governance, policies, and documentation for revenue operations processes including lead management, opportunity management, segmentation, and data standards. Lead cross-functional collaboration with IT, data, sales, and product teams to ensure system integrity, security, and operational excellence. Mentor and develop a team of revenue systems specialists, Salesforce experts, and process analysts while fostering a high-performance and collaborative culture. Requirements 8–12+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Systems leadership roles in high-growth SaaS or scale-up environments. Proven track record of leading revenue systems strategy, CRM architecture, and complex GTM technology ecosystems. Deep expertise with Salesforce and strong familiarity with tools such as CPQ, Outreach, Clari, LeanData, 6sense, ZoomInfo, LeadIQ, or equivalent platforms. Strong understanding of revenue lifecycle processes, including lead routing, opportunity management, segmentation, and forecasting systems. Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional projects, lead change management initiatives, and drive adoption of complex systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business challenges into scalable technical solutions. Experience leading and mentoring technical or operations teams in a fast-paced, global environment. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior GTM and executive leadership. Benefits Competitive global compensation package aligned with senior leadership roles. Fully remote, asynchronous work environment with high flexibility. Stock options and long-term incentive programs depending on role and location. Comprehensive benefits including health, wellness, mental health support, and parental leave. Learning and development budget to support continuous professional growth. Home office setup allowance and support for remote work infrastructure. Opportunity to shape a global, AI-driven revenue engine at scale.

Deep expertise across cybersecurity domains including cloud security, IAM, SOC, GRC, application security, and data protection. Proven ability to engage with C-level stakeholders and act as a trusted advisor on security strategy and risk management. Strong understanding of AI-driven cybersecurity capabilities, threat detection automation, and security for AI systems. title: EDI Medical Business Analyst
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for an EDI Medical Business Analyst in United States. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare operations, data integration, and technical business analysis, supporting critical electronic data interchange (EDI) processes within a mission-driven environment. You will work closely with business, development, and testing teams to translate complex healthcare and technical requirements into clear, actionable user stories and system specifications. The position plays a key role in ensuring accurate and efficient data exchange across healthcare systems, including claims, eligibility, and payment transactions. You will be responsible for bridging communication between stakeholders while supporting integration, testing, and validation activities. The role requires strong analytical thinking, deep understanding of healthcare data standards, and the ability to operate in Agile environments. It is an opportunity to contribute to high-impact systems that support healthcare delivery and improve operational efficiency at scale. Gather, analyze, and document detailed business and technical requirements for EDI-related epics, features, and user stories. Serve as a liaison between business stakeholders, developers, testers, and external partners to clarify EDI requirements and resolve issues. Support end-to-end EDI integration testing, validation, and onboarding with third-party vendors and trading partners. Design, map, and maintain EDI workflows, processes, and data exchange structures across healthcare systems. Translate complex healthcare business needs into structured functional and technical specifications. Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and daily stand-ups. Develop process flows, documentation, test plans, and project materials to support delivery and implementation. Identify and recommend improvements to existing EDI processes, systems, and operational workflows. Support troubleshooting and issue resolution related to EDI transactions and data exchange failures. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical field. 5+ years of experience in IT operations, systems analysis, or EDI-focused business analysis roles. Strong knowledge of healthcare EDI standards and transactions (e.g., 837, 835, 270/271, 999, 277). Hands-on experience with EDI mapping, processing, onboarding, testing, and troubleshooting. Understanding of HIPAA, X12/EDIFACT standards, and healthcare data exchange protocols. Experience working with EDI tools such as Gentran, IBM Sterling Integrator, or similar platforms. Familiarity with SQL, data workflows, ETL processes, and healthcare data systems. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, including user story development and backlog management. Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality documentation under deadlines. Nice to have: experience with HL7, FHIR, MuleSoft, RabbitMQ, or similar integration technologies. Benefits: Competitive salary ranging from $55,730 to $73,500, depending on experience and location. Remote-first work arrangement within the United States. Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance coverage. 401(k) retirement plan with employer match. Paid time off, holidays, and military leave options. Tuition reimbursement and certification support (including Agile/Scrum certifications). Flexible savings accounts (FSA/HSA), disability coverage, and life insurance. Training programs and career mobility opportunities within a mission-driven organization.

content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Fraud Risk Management Lead in the United States. High ownership mindset with the ability to operate independently in a fast-evolving, high-growth environment. Strong growth potential in a rapidly scaling organization.

In this role, you will develop social-first, performance-driven creative concepts that connect with audiences and drive measurable impact. You’ll work across digital, video, print, and experiential formats while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver standout work. The position also offers the chance to explore how AI-powered tools can enhance ideation, streamline production, and accelerate creative workflows. Ideal candidates are strategic thinkers with strong visual storytelling skills, a sharp eye for design, and the ability to balance creativity with performance objectives. This fully remote role offers flexibility, autonomy, and the opportunity to contribute to a wide range of innovative campaigns. Conceptualize and design high-performing creative campaigns across social media, digital advertising, video, email, landing pages, and additional marketing channels. Develop and adapt creative assets for print, out-of-home advertising, broadcast, and other multimedia formats as needed. Collaborate closely with Account Management and Project Management teams to ensure projects remain aligned with client objectives, timelines, and deliverables. Contribute innovative ideas and strategic creative solutions that strengthen brand storytelling and audience engagement. Integrate AI-powered creative tools into brainstorming, design exploration, and production workflows where they improve efficiency or elevate creative outcomes. Maintain strong attention to detail while managing multiple projects simultaneously in a deadline-driven environment. Participate actively in feedback sessions, creative reviews, and collaborative brainstorming to refine concepts and optimize campaign performance. Requirements: 1–2+ years of experience in an agency or fast-paced creative environment. Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in social-first, performance-focused creative campaigns across multiple platforms. Advanced proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign; experience with Premiere Pro and After Effects is a plus. Solid understanding of digital design principles, creative strategy, branding, and visual storytelling. Experience creating work across digital, video, web, print, and motion design formats. Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to clearly articulate creative concepts and design rationale. Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and revisions without compromising quality. Curiosity and openness toward emerging technologies, including AI tools that support creative ideation and production. Collaborative mindset combined with the ability to work independently and proactively in remote environments. Bachelor’s degree in Design or a related field is preferred. Availability to work within PST business hours is required. Benefits: Fully remote freelance opportunity with flexible work arrangements. Exposure to diverse projects across multiple industries and high-visibility campaigns. Opportunity to collaborate with multidisciplinary creative and strategy teams. Creative environment that encourages experimentation, innovation, and AI-enhanced workflows. Ability to build and expand a strong professional portfolio with impactful brand work. Fast-paced and collaborative culture that values creativity, initiative, and fresh ideas. Opportunity to work with both established brands and emerging businesses across various sectors.

Join a globally distributed technology environment focused on delivering exceptional customer experiences across publishing, commerce, and digital communication platforms. This role combines technical support, customer success, product advocacy, and operational improvement within a highly collaborative remote-first culture. You will work directly with customers to solve technical issues, guide product adoption, and help users achieve their goals through thoughtful and empathetic support. Beyond daily customer interactions, you will contribute to process improvements, internal knowledge sharing, and innovative support initiatives that elevate the overall customer journey. The position is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-changing environments, enjoys meaningful problem-solving, and values autonomy and continuous learning. With strong long-term career growth opportunities and exposure to multiple business functions, this role offers both personal development and impactful contribution within a mission-driven organization. Deliver high-quality customer support through email, live chat, and other communication channels while maintaining strong customer satisfaction and engagement levels. Troubleshoot technical issues related to WordPress, WooCommerce, websites, plugins, hosting environments, and digital publishing workflows. Guide customers through platform features, best practices, and product capabilities to help them achieve publishing, commerce, and operational goals. Identify recurring customer pain points and proactively recommend improvements to workflows, documentation, support processes, and product experiences. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to advocate for customer needs and contribute valuable insights related to usability, bugs, and feature enhancements. Participate in onboarding initiatives, support experiments, operational improvements, and new customer success programs designed to improve retention and engagement. Create and maintain internal and customer-facing documentation, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge resources to support scalable service delivery. Mentor peers, contribute to team collaboration, and help strengthen a culture of continuous improvement, learning, and customer-centric thinking. Utilize AI-powered tools, workflows, and automations to improve efficiency, streamline support operations, and enhance customer outcomes. Requirements: Hands-on experience with WordPress and/or WooCommerce beyond personal hobby use, including troubleshooting, customization, or operational support. Previous experience in customer support, technical support, customer success, or related customer-facing roles, ideally within SaaS or technology-driven environments. Strong technical troubleshooting abilities with the capability to explain complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical users. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to build trust and maintain professional customer relationships. Proven ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and succeed within highly autonomous remote work environments. Demonstrated initiative in improving processes, increasing efficiency, enhancing customer experiences, or contributing measurable operational impact. Comfortable handling high-volume customer interactions while maintaining empathy, responsiveness, and attention to detail. Strong collaboration mindset with the ability to work effectively across distributed teams and asynchronous communication channels. Familiarity with AI tools, workflow automation, or productivity-enhancing technologies used to improve support operations or personal efficiency. Additional expertise in technical troubleshooting, eCommerce, operational support, leadership, or process optimization is considered an advantage. Multilingual communication skills are beneficial but not required. Benefits: Fully remote work environment with flexibility to work from anywhere. Competitive global salary structure paid in local currency. Open vacation policy supporting work-life balance and personal flexibility. Long-term career development opportunities within customer success, leadership, operations, product, marketing, and other business areas. Strong internal mobility and professional growth culture with opportunities to expand into new initiatives and specialized roles. Collaborative global team environment with continuous peer support and knowledge sharing. Exposure to open-source technologies, digital publishing platforms, eCommerce ecosystems, and innovative customer experience practices. Opportunity to work in a mission-driven organization focused on democratizing publishing, commerce, and online communication. Inclusive and diverse workplace culture committed to accessibility, equal opportunity, and employee well-being.

title: Head of AI
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Head of AI in Germany. This is a unique opportunity for a highly technical and entrepreneurial AI leader to shape the future of intelligent business automation within a rapidly evolving SaaS environment. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of AI architecture, product innovation, and engineering leadership, building scalable systems that transform how businesses manage critical operations. You will work closely with executive leadership to define and execute a long-term AI vision while remaining deeply hands-on in the development of production-ready solutions. The position is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys solving complex workflow challenges, and is motivated by measurable business impact. You’ll lead the development of AI agents, automation frameworks, and LLM-powered systems that integrate directly into operational business processes. Working within a collaborative and international remote-first culture, you’ll help drive innovation, revenue growth, and the creation of a new generation of AI-powered enterprise software. Design, architect, and evolve scalable AI systems, including AI agents, LLM integrations, automation workflows, and RAG-based knowledge retrieval frameworks. Build and deploy production-ready AI solutions that integrate deeply into operational business processes and ERP environments. Collaborate directly with executive leadership to define AI strategy, identify automation opportunities, and align technology initiatives with business growth objectives. Lead by technical example through hands-on coding, system design, and implementation of event-driven architectures and intelligent automation pipelines. Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing AI engineering team while fostering a fast-paced, execution-oriented engineering culture. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders to drive AI adoption across the organization and ensure practical, customer-focused outcomes. Establish scalable infrastructure, reliability standards, and best practices for AI system performance, maintainability, and security. Act as the internal AI expert, educating teams on the capabilities, limitations, and strategic applications of emerging AI technologies. Continuously evaluate customer workflows and market needs to deliver innovative solutions that solve real operational challenges. Requirements: Proven experience as a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, Technical Founder, or similar senior technical leadership role in AI-driven environments. Strong expertise in backend architecture, distributed systems, API design, and scalable cloud-based infrastructure. Deep hands-on experience with LLM orchestration, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), automation systems, and data pipelines. Demonstrated ability to move rapidly from concept to production-ready implementation while maintaining a strong focus on business value and customer impact. Experience leading engineering teams through technical mentorship, hiring, and execution-focused leadership. Strong product mindset with the ability to connect technical innovation to commercial outcomes and operational efficiency. Comfortable working autonomously in fast-moving, high-ambiguity startup or scale-up environments. Fluency in both English and German is required. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to align cross-functional teams around AI initiatives. Passion for simplifying complex business processes through practical and scalable AI solutions. Benefits: Flexible remote-first work environment with the option to work across Europe or from multiple office hubs. Competitive compensation package with attractive salary and long-term career growth opportunities. 28 days of annual leave plus additional special leave and care days. Monthly flexible benefits voucher covering wellness, groceries, entertainment, sports, and lifestyle services. Comprehensive home office equipment package and remote work support. Professional development and continuous learning budget to support technical and personal growth. Mental health and well-being support including counseling, therapy assistance, legal guidance, and financial advisory services. Inclusive and international work culture with employees across multiple European countries and diverse backgrounds. Minimal hierarchy environment that promotes autonomy, collaboration, and respectful communication. Access to virtual and in-person company events designed to strengthen culture and team connection.

In this role, you will operate at the intersection of AI architecture, product innovation, and engineering leadership, building scalable systems that transform how businesses manage critical operations. You will work closely with executive leadership to define and execute a long-term AI vision while remaining deeply hands-on in the development of production-ready solutions. The position is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys solving complex workflow challenges, and is motivated by measurable business impact. You’ll lead the development of AI agents, automation frameworks, and LLM-powered systems that integrate directly into operational business processes. Working within a collaborative and international remote-first culture, you’ll help drive innovation, revenue growth, and the creation of a new generation of AI-powered enterprise software. Design, architect, and evolve scalable AI systems, including AI agents, LLM integrations, automation workflows, and RAG-based knowledge retrieval frameworks. Build and deploy production-ready AI solutions that integrate deeply into operational business processes and ERP environments. Collaborate directly with executive leadership to define AI strategy, identify automation opportunities, and align technology initiatives with business growth objectives. Lead by technical example through hands-on coding, system design, and implementation of event-driven architectures and intelligent automation pipelines. Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing AI engineering team while fostering a fast-paced, execution-oriented engineering culture. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders to drive AI adoption across the organization and ensure practical, customer-focused outcomes. Establish scalable infrastructure, reliability standards, and best practices for AI system performance, maintainability, and security. Act as the internal AI expert, educating teams on the capabilities, limitations, and strategic applications of emerging AI technologies. Continuously evaluate customer workflows and market needs to deliver innovative solutions that solve real operational challenges. Requirements: Proven experience as a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, Technical Founder, or similar senior technical leadership role in AI-driven environments. Strong expertise in backend architecture, distributed systems, API design, and scalable cloud-based infrastructure. Deep hands-on experience with LLM orchestration, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), automation systems, and data pipelines. Demonstrated ability to move rapidly from concept to production-ready implementation while maintaining a strong focus on business value and customer impact. Experience leading engineering teams through technical mentorship, hiring, and execution-focused leadership. Strong product mindset with the ability to connect technical innovation to commercial outcomes and operational efficiency. Comfortable working autonomously in fast-moving, high-ambiguity startup or scale-up environments. Fluency in both English and German is required. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to align cross-functional teams around AI initiatives. Passion for simplifying complex business processes through practical and scalable AI solutions. Benefits: Flexible remote-first work environment with the option to work across Europe or from multiple office hubs. Competitive compensation package with attractive salary and long-term career growth opportunities. 28 days of annual leave plus additional special leave and care days. Monthly flexible benefits voucher covering wellness, groceries, entertainment, sports, and lifestyle services. Comprehensive home office equipment package and remote work support. Professional development and continuous learning budget to support technical and personal growth. Mental health and well-being support including counseling, therapy assistance, legal guidance, and financial advisory services. Inclusive and international work culture with employees across multiple European countries and diverse backgrounds. Minimal hierarchy environment that promotes autonomy, collaboration, and respectful communication. Access to virtual and in-person company events designed to strengthen culture and team connection.

title: Head of Commercial Strategy & Projects, Point of Care
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Head of Commercial Strategy & Projects, Point of Care in United States. This leadership role sits at the core of global commercial transformation within a fast-evolving diagnostics business, shaping how strategy is defined, executed, and measured across international markets. You will drive the commercial vision for Point of Care solutions, translating enterprise priorities into actionable initiatives that deliver sustainable growth and competitive differentiation. Acting as a key bridge between strategy and execution, you will ensure strong alignment between global product, R&D, and regional commercial teams. The role requires a balance of strategic foresight, analytical rigor, and operational discipline to turn insights into impactful business outcomes. You will also serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, influencing high-stakes decisions and long-term direction. This is a highly visible position at the intersection of innovation, healthcare impact, and global commercial execution. Define and lead the global commercial strategy for the Point of Care business, ensuring alignment with enterprise objectives and market dynamics. Translate market, customer, and competitive insights into differentiated value propositions and actionable strategic priorities. Drive end-to-end commercial transformation initiatives, defining clear success metrics, timelines, and measurable outcomes. Establish strong cross-functional alignment between Product Management, R&D, regional teams, and commercial stakeholders from strategy inception through execution. Develop go-to-market strategies, playbooks, and sales enablement frameworks to ensure consistent execution across geographies. Oversee strategic governance, performance tracking, and reporting to ensure clarity on key business drivers and outcomes. Lead prioritization of initiatives, balancing growth opportunities, resource allocation, and execution feasibility. Serve as a key advisor to executive leadership, providing insights on market trends, commercial performance, and strategic direction. Requirements This role requires extensive experience in commercial strategy, sales operations, or business transformation within complex, global organizations, ideally in healthcare or medical technology. Candidates should combine strong analytical capabilities with executive-level communication and stakeholder influence skills. 10+ years of experience in commercial strategy, sales, marketing, or business performance management roles. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field; MBA preferred. Strong expertise in forecasting, KPI development, and sales or commercial performance optimization. Proven ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and strategic recommendations. Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product, and R&D teams. Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with experience influencing senior executives. Advanced analytical skills with experience using CRM and BI tools such as Salesforce, Power BI, or Tableau. Ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives in a fast-paced, global environment. Strong understanding of go-to-market strategy development and commercial execution frameworks. Excellent communication and storytelling skills to drive alignment and organizational focus. Benefits Competitive base salary ranging from $177,300 to $243,782 annually, depending on experience and location. Eligibility for performance-based compensation, including bonus and/or commission components. Comprehensive health coverage including medical, dental, and vision insurance. Retirement savings plan with 401(k) options. Paid time off, sick leave, and additional work-life balance benefits. Life insurance, short-term and long-term disability coverage. Hybrid and flexible working arrangements depending on role requirements. Professional development opportunities within a global healthcare technology organization. Inclusive and diverse workplace culture focused on innovation and impact in healthcare.

content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Healthcare Payor Change/Reverification Representative in the United States. Monitor and review Medicare and non-Medicare reverification cycles to ensure accuracy in billing and eligibility. Verify patient insurance eligibility and payer coverage details to support timely and accurate claims processing. Identify and resolve billing issues such as batch errors, bill holds, and missing documentation affecting revenue. Generate weekly revenue reports and communicate outstanding documentation issues to site leadership. Prepare and submit invoices to Accounts Payable and conduct follow-ups to ensure timely reimbursement. Coordinate documentation review for Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payer requirements to support clean claims submission. Ensure internal controls, payer requirements, and compliance standards are consistently followed. Serve as a liaison between sites, facilities, and AR teams to maintain smooth revenue cycle operations. Support team continuity by assisting with workload coverage and ensuring timely completion of tasks during absences. Requirements The ideal candidate brings experience in healthcare revenue cycle processes, strong analytical ability, and a detail-oriented approach to compliance and documentation: 1+ years of experience in accounts receivable, insurance claims, eligibility verification, or related healthcare revenue cycle functions. Strong understanding of insurance verification, payer guidelines, and reimbursement workflows. Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools including Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams. Ability to interpret payer requirements such as pre-certification, authorization, and level-of-care documentation. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workflows and deadlines. Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in data review and documentation. Effective communication skills for collaborating with healthcare sites and internal teams. Preferred: Associate degree or additional experience in payer alignment or reverification processes. Ability to work independently in a remote environment with secure handling of PHI/HIPAA information. Benefits Annual salary range: $43,000 – $56,200 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance 401(k) retirement savings plan Paid time off, holidays, volunteer time off, and parental/caregiver leave Short-term and long-term disability coverage Life insurance benefits Remote work with equipment support provided by employer Internet reimbursement (for eligible home-based employees in select states) Employee wellness and whole-person health support programs Opportunities to work in a mission-driven healthcare environment focused on patient-centered care

content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Staff Product Designer. In this role, you will have a significant impact on millions of users, helping to shape the look, feel, and functionality of an innovative AI-powered application. You'll lead key design initiatives, ensuring that the user experience is seamless and engaging. This opportunity allows you to work collaboratively with research, product, and engineering teams to create designs that drive user retention and satisfaction. Proven ability to own projects end-to-end — from research and concept to launch and iteration. Experience building and evolving design systems in collaboration with engineering teams. Comfort working in fast-paced environments and delivering quality work quickly. Excellent communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams. Bonus: experience in marketplaces, fintech, mobility, or insurance. Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage. Paid time off and paid parental leave. 401(K) plan with employer matching. Wellness benefits and equity opportunities. Work remotely from anywhere. Collaborative and innovative team culture.

content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Lead Product Marketing Manager, Growth & Lifecycle in Ireland. Join a fast-growing AI-driven SaaS environment focused on transforming how short-term rental hosts manage and automate their daily operations. This role offers the opportunity to lead growth and lifecycle strategy across the entire customer journey, from acquisition and activation to retention and expansion. Working at the intersection of product marketing, lifecycle optimization, behavioral analytics, and conversion strategy, you will directly influence how users discover, adopt, and engage with an emerging AI-powered platform. The position is ideal for a data-driven marketer who thrives in highly autonomous startup environments and enjoys combining experimentation with high-impact messaging. You will shape positioning, onboarding experiences, lifecycle campaigns, and conversion strategies while collaborating closely with product and growth teams. With significant ownership over funnel performance and customer engagement initiatives, this role offers both strategic influence and measurable business impact. Own and optimize the full customer funnel, including signup, activation, trial engagement, paid conversion, retention, and expansion initiatives. Design and execute lifecycle marketing strategies across onboarding, in-product messaging, re-engagement campaigns, and customer retention programs. Lead trial-to-paid conversion initiatives by improving onboarding experiences, upgrade journeys, pricing communication, and activation moments. Develop and refine product positioning and messaging strategies that clearly communicate value propositions and strengthen market differentiation. Manage and optimize landing pages, messaging frameworks, and conversion flows through continuous experimentation and performance analysis. Conduct funnel analysis, cohort tracking, segmentation studies, and retention modeling to identify growth opportunities and improve lifecycle performance. Write and oversee high-converting copy for landing pages, email campaigns, onboarding flows, and in-product communication experiences. Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and growth stakeholders to align lifecycle initiatives with overall business objectives. Run growth experiments and A/B tests to improve customer acquisition, engagement, conversion rates, and long-term retention metrics. Requirements: 6+ years of experience in product marketing, growth marketing, or lifecycle marketing roles within SaaS or technology-driven environments. Proven experience managing self-serve B2C or low-ACV B2B SaaS funnels with measurable impact on activation, conversion, or retention metrics. Strong expertise in lifecycle marketing strategies including onboarding flows, winback campaigns, in-product messaging, and customer engagement programs. Demonstrated ability to analyze and improve funnel performance through experimentation, cohort analysis, retention modeling, and data-driven decision-making. Exceptional copywriting skills with experience creating landing pages, email campaigns, lifecycle messaging, and conversion-focused product communication. Strong understanding of growth metrics, behavioral analytics, customer segmentation, and lifecycle optimization frameworks. Ability to independently own and execute projects within fast-paced startup environments with minimal oversight. Native or near-native English communication skills, particularly for customer-facing messaging and product marketing content. Strategic mindset combined with hands-on execution capabilities and a strong focus on measurable business outcomes. Comfortable working in rapidly evolving product environments where experimentation, iteration, and adaptability are essential. Benefits: Fully remote work environment with flexibility to work from anywhere. Premium tooling access and software stipend to support productivity and performance. Competitive compensation package with milestone-based bonuses tied to lifecycle and growth performance metrics. Meaningful equity participation aligned with long-term company success and impact. Full ownership of lifecycle and funnel optimization initiatives with high autonomy and decision-making authority. Opportunity to become the first dedicated Product Marketing leader and shape growth strategy from the ground up. Exposure to innovative AI-powered product experiences and fast-scaling SaaS operations.

Excellent collaboration, communication, and organizational skills in cross-functional and remote environments. title: Marketing Project Coordinator
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Marketing Project Coordinator in United Kingdom. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly organized and proactive professional to work at the intersection of marketing, sales enablement, and campaign operations within an international B2B technology environment. In this role, you will coordinate multiple moving parts across agencies, sales initiatives, and campaign deliverables to ensure smooth execution and measurable business impact. You will play a key role in transforming marketing assets into effective sales tools while supporting large-scale co-marketing initiatives across multiple European markets. The position offers significant ownership from day one, allowing you to influence processes, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute directly to pipeline growth. Ideal for candidates who thrive in fast-paced remote environments, this role combines strategic coordination, stakeholder management, and operational excellence within a growing and collaborative team. Coordinate and manage the sales-enablement workstream of large-scale co-marketing campaigns across multiple European markets. Source, onboard, and manage SDR and external agency partners to support outbound sales and lead generation activities. Transform campaign content into practical sales collateral, including landing pages, email sequences, newsletters, one-pagers, and sales outreach materials. Coordinate copywriting, design, and development agencies to ensure timely delivery of branded and compliant marketing assets. Track budgets, maintain reporting accuracy, and manage documentation related to campaign execution and proof-of-performance requirements. Ensure strong alignment between marketing activities and sales objectives, helping drive engagement, pipeline growth, and measurable outcomes. Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners to maintain smooth communication and operational efficiency across multiple workstreams. Support continuous improvement of campaign processes, coordination workflows, and reporting standards. Requirements: Minimum 2 years of experience coordinating multiple projects, stakeholders, or campaigns simultaneously. Previous exposure to outbound sales, SDR operations, lead generation, or sales enablement environments. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage priorities in a fast-paced and evolving remote environment. Experience working with project management tools, spreadsheets, and collaborative workflow systems. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to work independently, take ownership, and proactively solve problems without constant supervision. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage deadlines, budgets, and compliance-related documentation. Interest in B2B SaaS, cloud technologies, vendor co-marketing, or technology partnerships is considered an advantage. Comfortable collaborating with agencies, cross-functional teams, and international stakeholders. Benefits: Fully remote freelance/contractor opportunity within the European region. Flexible part-time engagement with potential to scale toward full-time as campaigns grow. Opportunity to take ownership of a key workstream from day one. Exposure to large-scale vendor co-marketing and international campaign operations. Fast-paced and collaborative work culture focused on initiative and autonomy. Opportunity to work with international teams and technology-focused marketing programs. Career growth potential as campaign scope and responsibilities expand. Flexible working environment with high levels of independence and impact.

This role is a high-impact sales leadership opportunity focused on driving mid-market revenue growth within the manufacturing and industrial SaaS space. You will lead a team responsible for acquiring new enterprise logos and expanding adoption of advanced condition monitoring solutions that improve operational uptime. The position blends strategic sales leadership with hands-on coaching, requiring close involvement in deal execution and customer engagement. You will play a key role in shaping go-to-market strategy, refining messaging, and building scalable sales motions. Working in a fast-growing, mission-driven environment, you will collaborate across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Business Development teams. This is an opportunity to directly influence revenue performance while helping industrial customers modernize and optimize their operations. Lead and manage a team of Mid-Market Solution Architects focused on new logo acquisition and revenue growth. Drive achievement of sales targets and corporate revenue objectives across mid-market accounts. Partner closely with Account Executives to execute strategic sales plans and close key opportunities. Coach and develop sales team members through active deal support, call participation, and performance management. Develop and refine sales messaging, personas, playbooks, and go-to-market motions tailored to industrial and manufacturing clients. Maintain and expand a strong network within the manufacturing and industrial sector at the executive level. Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Success, and Business Development teams to align sales execution. Analyze sales performance data to identify trends, improve efficiency, and optimize team structure. Represent the organization at industry events, trade shows, and customer engagements. Stay informed on market trends, competitive activity, and emerging customer opportunities. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience. 5+ years of SaaS sales experience, ideally within manufacturing, industrial, or technical B2B environments. 3+ years of experience leading and managing high-performing SaaS sales teams. Proven track record of consistently achieving and exceeding revenue targets. Strong understanding of mid-market and enterprise sales cycles, including pilot and proof-of-concept processes. Experience building GTM strategies, sales frameworks, and structured playbooks. Established network within manufacturing or industrial industries with strong executive relationships. Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to manage complex, multi-threaded deals. Data-driven mindset with experience using sales tools and analytics to improve performance. Excellent communication, leadership, and presentation abilities. Benefits: Competitive compensation package including base salary and stock options. Unlimited paid time off and flexible work arrangements. Comprehensive benefits package including retirement plan with employer match. Fully remote-first work environment with collaboration across distributed teams. Opportunity to have a direct impact on company growth and industry transformation. Work alongside a dynamic, high-growth team in a mission-driven environment. Flexible schedule supporting work-life balance and autonomy.

title: Mid/Senior AI Cinematic Video Editor
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Mid/Senior AI Cinematic Video Editor in United States. In this highly creative and innovation-driven role, you will lead the production of cinematic AI-generated video content that blends storytelling, visual artistry, and cutting-edge generative technologies. You will work across the full production lifecycle — from concept development and prompting to editing, compositing, and final delivery — creating immersive long-form narratives powered by AI-first workflows. This role offers the opportunity to experiment with emerging AI video tools while shaping visually compelling content at scale in a rapidly evolving creative environment. You will collaborate closely with creative leadership while maintaining significant autonomy over technical execution and artistic direction. Ideal for a technically skilled storyteller with strong visual instincts, the position combines cinematic editing, AI experimentation, motion design, and workflow optimization. The environment is remote-first, fast-moving, highly collaborative, and centered around creativity, ownership, and continuous innovation. Conceptualize and develop narrative-driven video content centered around existing AI-generated characters and creative storylines. Manage end-to-end AI video production workflows, including ideation, prompting, asset generation, editing, compositing, and final post-production delivery. Utilize advanced AI video generation platforms and emerging creative technologies to produce cinematic visual sequences and long-form content. Maintain visual consistency across characters, scenes, pacing, and storytelling elements throughout complex narrative productions. Integrate motion graphics, visual effects, sound synchronization, and color correction techniques to create polished final outputs. Collaborate closely with creative leadership to align content production with broader artistic direction and campaign goals. Rapidly experiment with new AI models, tools, and production techniques to improve workflow efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Optimize AI-assisted production pipelines while documenting best practices and sharing technical knowledge with internal teams. Balance creative storytelling with technical execution to deliver visually engaging, emotionally impactful, and high-performing content. Contribute innovative ideas and creative solutions within a fast-paced environment focused on emerging AI-driven entertainment experiences. Requirements: 4–6+ years of experience in video production, cinematic editing, VFX, digital art, or related creative disciplines. Strong portfolio showcasing AI-generated video work, cinematic storytelling, or advanced digital content production. Hands-on experience with modern AI video generation tools and workflows, including prompting, consistency techniques, and post-processing pipelines. Proficiency with editing and post-production software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or equivalent creative platforms. Strong understanding of cinematic composition, pacing, visual storytelling, scene continuity, and editing principles. Ability to independently manage projects from concept development through final production delivery. Experience maintaining character and visual consistency across AI-generated long-form video sequences. Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in remote and cross-functional creative teams. Experimental and adaptable mindset with enthusiasm for rapidly evolving AI technologies and creative workflows. Comfortable working within uncensored or adult-oriented content production environments when required. Familiarity with tools such as ComfyUI, Stable Diffusion, AUTOMATIC1111, LoRAs, embeddings, or fine-tuning workflows is considered a strong advantage. Background in AI-native filmmaking, VFX, 3D production, technical art, or color grading is a plus. Benefits: Fully remote work environment with flexibility to work from anywhere. Flexible contract structure with long-term growth opportunities. 20 paid working days of annual PTO. Annual in-person company gathering and team collaboration events. Monthly health and wellness allowance. Access to mental health and lifestyle support services for employees and eligible family members. Co-working space reimbursement to support productivity and collaboration. Dedicated learning and professional development budget for courses, certifications, conferences, and creative resources. Company-provided laptop and workspace equipment support. Premium access to leading AI and creative tools including ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code, Hugging Face, and additional workflow technologies. Opportunity to work alongside high-performing global talent within a rapidly scaling AI-focused organization. Exposure to category-defining AI products and cutting-edge generative media innovation.

title: ML Developer Experience Engineer
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a ML Developer Experience Engineer in United States. This is a high-impact engineering role focused on shaping how machine learning and reinforcement learning systems are built, evaluated, and deployed at scale. You will design developer-centric tools, SDKs, and workflows that abstract away the complexity of RL, making advanced ML capabilities accessible to engineering teams and enterprise customers. The role sits at the intersection of machine learning infrastructure, product engineering, and developer experience, with direct influence on how customers adopt and scale production-grade AI systems. You will work closely with product, engineering, and technical success teams to identify friction points and translate them into scalable, reusable platform capabilities. Your work will directly enable faster adoption of RL workflows across organizations while improving reliability, usability, and performance. This is a hands-on, systems-level role for someone passionate about developer experience and modern ML infrastructure. Design and build developer-focused SDKs, APIs, libraries, and tooling that simplify reinforcement learning workflows for ML engineers and developers. Create intuitive abstractions that balance ease of use with flexibility for advanced configuration and experimentation. Translate customer feedback and usage patterns into improved tooling, documentation, onboarding flows, and reusable platform components. Collaborate with product, engineering, and customer success teams to identify workflow bottlenecks and design scalable technical solutions. Develop and maintain high-quality documentation, tutorials, and example implementations to support developer adoption and success. Improve system reliability through robust testing, edge-case handling, and production-grade software engineering practices. Contribute to the evolution of internal frameworks and platform capabilities based on real-world customer needs and usage data. Requirements: Strong experience building developer-facing tools such as SDKs, APIs, libraries, or frameworks used in production environments. Proficiency in Python, with additional experience in ML ecosystem languages considered a plus. Solid understanding of machine learning workflows including training, evaluation, and deployment pipelines. Experience improving developer productivity through tooling, documentation, and product-driven engineering. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, usable, and well-documented developer experiences. Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, and customer-facing roles. Familiarity with ML infrastructure, distributed systems, or frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX is a plus. Contributions to open-source projects or internal developer platforms is highly valued. Strong product mindset with an emphasis on usability, scalability, and developer empathy. Benefits: Competitive compensation aligned with market benchmarks and experience level. Comprehensive health coverage including medical, dental, and vision insurance (or equivalent depending on location). Retirement or pension contribution plans based on regional standards. Unlimited PTO with strong encouragement to take at least 5 weeks annually. Mental health, wellness, and personal development stipends. Flexible hybrid or remote work arrangements depending on location. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge reinforcement learning and AI infrastructure technologies. Visa sponsorship support available for relocation where applicable.

title: ML Infrastructure Engineer
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a ML Infrastructure Engineer in Netherlands. Join a cutting-edge AI infrastructure environment focused on powering the next generation of machine learning and large-scale AI workloads. This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of GPU performance engineering, deep learning optimization, and cloud-scale infrastructure development. You will contribute directly to benchmarking and optimizing advanced GPU platforms that support training and inference for complex neural networks and AI systems. Working alongside highly skilled engineering and hardware teams, you will help drive performance improvements across compute architectures, software stacks, and distributed AI environments. The position is ideal for engineers passionate about ML systems, large-scale model performance, and infrastructure innovation. With exposure to modern AI frameworks, high-performance GPU ecosystems, and international collaboration, this role provides a strong platform for technical growth and meaningful impact within the AI industry. Benchmark and evaluate GPU platform performance for machine learning and AI workloads across various architectures, frameworks, and software environments. Collaborate closely with hardware and engineering teams to profile GPU performance at system and kernel levels and identify optimization opportunities. Analyze, debug, and optimize training and inference workloads to improve efficiency, scalability, and overall hardware utilization. Conduct acceptance testing for new GPU clusters to validate performance, stability, compatibility, and operational readiness for AI workloads. Perform experiments across multiple GPU configurations and interconnect strategies to assess system-level scalability and performance trade-offs. Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting abilities, communication skills, and attention to detail. content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for an Operations & Performance Manager, Lead Generation in United States. The position focuses on improving the technology, analytics, and operational processes behind lead acquisition campaigns to maximize efficiency, quality, and ROI. You will work cross-functionally with marketing, analytics, compliance, and technology teams to ensure seamless campaign execution and scalable growth strategies. Build and maintain reporting dashboards and analytics frameworks that provide visibility into lead quality, campaign effectiveness, and operational performance. Investigate performance anomalies, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to improve lead flow and downstream outcomes. Collaborate closely with marketing, compliance, analytics, and operational teams to align lead generation efforts with organizational goals and regulatory requirements. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make informed, data-driven decisions. Proficiency working with complex systems, integrations, data flows, and operational diagnostics. Experience collaborating with compliance, legal, or risk management teams in regulated environments. title: Product Manager, Defi Integrations
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Product Manager, DeFi Integrations in Ireland. This is a high-impact product role at the intersection of blockchain data, DeFi protocols, and user-facing financial tooling. You will own the quality and coverage of on-chain integrations that power a fast-growing crypto tax platform used by hundreds of thousands of investors globally. The role focuses on translating complex blockchain activity into accurate, reliable, and intuitive product experiences. You will work closely with engineering to define how DeFi protocols are interpreted, parsed, and surfaced to users in a meaningful way. Operating in a remote-first, async environment, you’ll have high autonomy to shape product direction and prioritise what gets built next. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep DeFi knowledge with strong product judgment and analytical thinking. Own the strategy, quality, and coverage of blockchain and DeFi integrations, ensuring accurate and reliable on-chain data ingestion. Analyse protocols, transaction data, and user behaviour to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for product improvement. Translate complex DeFi mechanics into clear product requirements and actionable engineering specifications. Prioritise integration work using customer feedback, market signals, and business impact to guide roadmap decisions. Collaborate closely with engineering teams to define, test, and ship improvements to data pipelines and integration logic. Continuously monitor blockchain ecosystems, competitor coverage, and protocol changes to ensure product relevance and accuracy. Make trade-offs between data quality, user experience, and growth impact to optimise product outcomes. Contribute to improving retention and engagement through better integration reliability and completeness. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally within crypto, fintech, data-heavy platforms, or technical SaaS products. Strong understanding of blockchain systems, DeFi protocols, and on-chain data structures, with the ability to interpret transaction-level data. Proven ability to work closely with engineering on complex technical products involving APIs, data pipelines, or system integrations. Deep analytical skills with the ability to turn raw data and protocol documentation into structured product decisions. Experience writing clear, technical product requirements and working in async or highly autonomous environments. Strong product judgment with the ability to balance user needs, technical constraints, and business impact. Familiarity with major DeFi ecosystems and an understanding of how protocols differ across chains. Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams. Comfortable making decisions in ambiguous, fast-evolving environments with limited structure. Benefits: Fully remote-first and async working environment with high autonomy. 32 days of paid leave including public holidays. Flexible working hours with a focus on output over process. Co-working space budget available if desired. Opportunity to work on a fast-growing, technically complex crypto product with real user impact. High-trust, low-meeting culture focused on deep work and execution. Exposure to cutting-edge blockchain and DeFi technologies. Strong engineering and product culture focused on quality and ownership.

title: Production Designer (Social/Digital Ads)
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Production Designer (Social/Digital Ads) in Poland. This role is focused on bringing digital and social campaigns to life through high-quality production design work across multiple formats and channels. You will translate established creative concepts into scalable, platform-ready assets for paid social, display advertising, and other digital environments. Working closely with art directors, designers, and copywriters, you will ensure consistency, precision, and visual excellence across all deliverables. The position is ideal for someone who enjoys detail-driven execution, fast-paced iteration, and maintaining strong design systems across large volumes of assets. You will play a key role in ensuring creative work is accurately adapted, resized, and optimized for performance across platforms. This is a remote opportunity requiring collaboration within PST business hours and offers exposure to a wide variety of brands and campaign types. Translate core creative concepts into multiple digital formats, adapting designs across various sizes, platforms, and channel requirements. Produce final production-ready assets for paid social, display banners, app creatives, and other digital campaign deliverables. Execute rapid design and copy updates while maintaining accuracy, consistency, and adherence to brand guidelines. Collaborate closely with art directors, designers, and copywriters to implement feedback and refine creative outputs efficiently. Prepare and deliver fully packaged final files for handoff and deployment across digital platforms. Support occasional original design contributions beyond production tasks when needed. Requirements: 2+ years of experience in production or graphic design within a creative agency, in-house studio, or similar environment. Strong portfolio demonstrating digital banner production, paid social assets, and multi-format campaign adaptation. Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and strong working knowledge of Figma. Excellent understanding of typography, layout, grid systems, and scalable design systems. High attention to detail with a strong commitment to pixel-perfect execution and quality control. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining organization and deadlines. Comfortable working independently as well as collaboratively in a feedback-driven environment. Benefits: Fully remote position with the flexibility of working from India. Opportunity to work on high-volume, large-scale digital campaigns for diverse global brands. Exposure to fast-paced creative workflows within an international agency environment. Collaborative team culture with close interaction with senior creative professionals. Chance to strengthen expertise in production design systems and multi-platform advertising. Work aligned with PST business hours, offering structured global collaboration.

In this role, you will serve as the subject matter expert in life underwriting, assessing and managing both medical and financial risks for a variety of cases. You will work with minimal supervision, and your decisions will directly impact underwriting processes. The role also involves collaboration with distribution teams and internal stakeholders to ensure effective communication of underwriting decisions. Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities. Experience with mentoring and coaching in a professional setting. Ability to work independently and manage complex cases. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plan options. Flexible spending and health savings accounts. Tuition reimbursement and student loan retirement program. Generous annual paid leave and 401(k) company match. Life insurance and wellness programs. Supportive and inclusive company culture. Remote work flexibility and opportunities for professional growth.

title: Remote Travel Advisor
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Remote Travel Advisor in Australia. This is an exciting opportunity for individuals passionate about travel and customer service to build a flexible, remote career in the travel industry. In this role, you will support clients in planning and booking a wide range of travel experiences, from cruises and resort stays to customized tours and vacation packages. You will work in a fully remote environment, helping travelers create seamless and memorable journeys while ensuring high-quality service at every step. The position offers the freedom to manage your own schedule while developing expertise in destinations, travel products, and supplier relationships. You will interact with leading travel partners and use online tools to coordinate bookings and manage client requests efficiently. This role is ideal for self-motivated individuals who enjoy organization, communication, and turning travel ideas into reality. Research, design, and coordinate personalized travel itineraries including flights, accommodations, cruises, tours, and activities. Assist clients throughout the full booking process, ensuring responsive, clear, and professional customer service. Stay informed about destination trends, travel requirements, supplier promotions, and industry updates. Communicate with travel suppliers to secure competitive pricing, availability, and exclusive travel offers. Manage client records, bookings, and inquiries using digital platforms and booking systems. Support outreach and promotional efforts to attract and retain new and existing clients. Ensure smooth travel planning experiences by providing accurate information and timely follow-ups. Maintain strong organization and attention to detail when handling multiple client requests. Requirements: Strong interest in travel planning, destinations, and creating memorable travel experiences. Excellent communication skills with a customer-focused and service-oriented mindset. Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks independently. Comfortable using basic computer tools, online platforms, and booking systems. Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work effectively in a remote environment. Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new travel tools, systems, and processes. No prior travel industry experience required; training and support are provided. Must be eligible to work from one of the supported countries and be 18+ years of age. Benefits: Fully remote work with the ability to operate from home anywhere in Australia. Flexible scheduling with no fixed shifts or mandatory quotas. Opportunity to build a career in the travel industry with full training provided. Access to a dedicated professional booking platform and travel tools. Partnerships with leading travel suppliers including cruises, resorts, and tour providers. Established support system with back-office assistance and industry guidance. Included Errors & Omissions (E&O) insurance coverage for added professional protection. Freedom to grow your own client base and develop a long-term travel business.

title: Research Lead / Principal Scientist & Manager Post-Training · Alignment · Reinforcement Learning Autodesk AI Lab
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Research Lead / Principal Scientist & Manager – Post-Training · Alignment · Reinforcement Learning in Canada. This role sits at the forefront of frontier AI research, focusing on transforming foundation models into reliable, aligned, and domain-ready systems. You will lead a growing team of AI scientists while remaining deeply hands-on in research, shaping post-training strategies that include reinforcement learning, preference optimization, and agentic reasoning systems. Operating within a highly advanced AI research environment, you will influence both long-term research direction and real-world product impact across industries such as architecture, engineering, manufacturing, and media. The position blends scientific leadership with execution, requiring strong judgment in model behavior, evaluation design, and alignment trade-offs. You will collaborate closely with infrastructure, product, and research teams to ensure scalable and reproducible training workflows. This is a high-impact leadership role where your work directly contributes to advancing trustworthy AI systems used in real-world professional workflows. You will define and lead the post-training and alignment research strategy, overseeing how foundation models are refined into robust, safe, and high-performing systems. You will guide both technical direction and team execution while staying actively engaged in experimentation and algorithm development. Lead post-training strategy across RLHF, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning for complex reasoning systems Develop novel algorithms to improve model alignment, controllability, reliability, and domain-specific performance Design and execute experiments to evaluate model behavior, robustness, reasoning quality, and safety Establish evaluation frameworks for long-horizon reasoning, agentic behavior, and real-world workflow completion Define model readiness criteria and provide go/no-go recommendations for deployment Manage, mentor, and grow a team of AI researchers while fostering a high-rigor scientific culture Collaborate with infrastructure and product teams to build scalable and reproducible training systems Contribute to publications, patents, and external research visibility in top-tier ML venues Translate technical findings into clear guidance for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders Requirements This role requires deep expertise in reinforcement learning and foundation model post-training, combined with proven research leadership experience. You should bring strong intuition for model behavior, alignment challenges, and large-scale AI system trade-offs. Extensive hands-on experience with reinforcement learning and post-training methods (RLHF, RLAIF, PPO, DPO, or similar) Proven experience leading or mentoring AI research teams in industry or academic settings Strong understanding of alignment challenges, model evaluation, and reasoning systems Experience designing rigorous evaluation frameworks for AI model performance and readiness Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs to diverse audiences Background in ML, AI, or RL research, typically supported by a PhD or equivalent industry research experience Preferred experience in frontier AI labs, agentic AI, or alignment research Familiarity with large-scale training infrastructure and production AI systems is an asset Strong publication record in top ML venues is highly valued Benefits Competitive compensation package including base salary, bonus, and equity components Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage Inclusive and collaborative research environment focused on real-world impact Flexible work arrangements, including remote options across North America and Europe Strong emphasis on research freedom, publication, and external visibility Professional development opportunities and access to cutting-edge AI infrastructure Paid time off, wellness programs, and employee support initiatives Opportunity to influence frontier AI systems used in high-impact industrial domains

title: Retail Media Reporting & Insights Analyst
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Retail Media Reporting & Insights Analyst in the United States. title: Revenue & Sales Operations Analyst
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Revenue & Sales Operations Analyst in Australia. This role sits at the heart of a high-impact Revenue Operations function, where data, strategy, and execution come together to drive sales performance across a global go-to-market organization. You will transform complex datasets into actionable insights that shape forecasting, planning, and commercial decision-making. Working closely with sales, finance, and regional leadership teams, you will help optimize revenue processes, improve visibility across KPIs, and strengthen operational efficiency. The environment is fast-paced, analytical, and highly collaborative, requiring both precision and adaptability. You will also play a key role in building scalable reporting frameworks and improving decision-support systems. This is an opportunity to directly influence revenue outcomes in a global, multi-region business operating at scale. In this role, you will support and enhance revenue and sales operations processes across reporting, analytics, and financial planning activities. You will be responsible for delivering accurate insights and improving decision-making through data-driven analysis. Develop and maintain dashboards, self-service reporting tools, and performance tracking systems for sales and revenue teams. Analyze sales KPIs, pipeline performance, and renewal metrics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. Support monthly business reviews by comparing actual results against forecasts and plans. Build and maintain financial models, scenario analyses, and headcount planning tools to support forecasting accuracy. Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to refine processes and improve data quality and reporting consistency. Deliver ad-hoc analysis and executive-level reporting to support strategic decisions. Contribute to territory, quota, and performance modeling to optimize go-to-market execution. Requirements The ideal candidate has strong analytical capability, experience in revenue or sales operations, and the ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations. You are comfortable working across multiple systems and collaborating with senior stakeholders in a global environment. 3–5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Analytics, or a similar role. Strong proficiency in Excel (including advanced functions such as Pivot Tables, macros, and modeling). Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms. Solid working knowledge of Salesforce and exposure to planning tools such as Anaplan. Strong financial modeling and forecasting experience, including scenario analysis. Strong expertise in RNA biology, translational mechanisms, gene therapy, or related therapeutic modalities. Hands-on experience with AAV vector design, gene delivery systems, and preclinical development workflows. Familiarity with LNP or alternative delivery technologies for nucleic acid therapeutics. Proven track record working with in vivo and in vitro disease models, including rodent models and ideally non-human primates. Strong ability to translate early-stage scientific discoveries into therapeutic development strategies. Strong communication skills with experience engaging scientific, clinical, and business stakeholders. Entrepreneurial mindset with a hands-on, execution-oriented approach to scientific leadership.
