title: Senior Account Manager (online advertising/digital media)
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior Account Manager (online advertising/digital media) in United States. This role sits at the intersection of digital advertising strategy, client success, and programmatic media execution, supporting high-value advertising campaigns across both direct and programmatic channels. You will take ownership of complex client portfolios, ensuring campaigns deliver strong performance, measurable ROI, and long-term value for advertisers. Acting as a trusted partner to both sales and clients, you will oversee the full post-sale lifecycle while shaping strategic account growth. The environment is fast-paced, data-driven, and highly collaborative, requiring strong cross-functional coordination across product, ad operations, and creative teams. You will also play a key role in mentoring junior team members and contributing to best practices across the organization. This is a highly impactful position where client success directly translates into revenue retention and expansion. It is ideal for someone who thrives in digital media innovation and performance-focused advertising environments. Own the full post-sale campaign lifecycle for strategic and high-budget accounts, including campaign setup, trafficking, QA, optimization, reporting, and wrap-up delivery across direct and programmatic channels. Manage and grow key client relationships, serving as the senior point of contact and ensuring high satisfaction, retention, and renewal success across assigned accounts. Partner closely with Sales, Product, Ad Operations, and creative teams to ensure seamless execution and alignment with client goals and technical requirements. Drive account growth strategies by identifying upsell opportunities, analyzing performance insights, and aligning solutions with client marketing objectives. Oversee complex multi-channel campaigns, ensuring accurate activation across DSPs, PMP deals, and RTB environments with strong performance outcomes. Support and mentor junior account team members, contributing to training, process improvement, and knowledge sharing across the organization. Requirements: 3+ years of experience in digital advertising, online media, account management, or media planning within a performance-driven environment. Strong understanding of programmatic ecosystems, including DSPs, SSPs, RTB, Deal IDs, and private marketplace buying models. Experience managing client relationships in agency, trading desk, or client-direct environments with a strong focus on retention and growth. Familiarity with ad tech and marketing tools such as Salesforce, DoubleClick, JIRA, IAS, and DoubleVerify. Solid understanding of campaign measurement, digital media metrics, and advertising revenue models. Ability to manage multiple complex campaigns simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and strong communication with stakeholders. Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate performance data into actionable optimization strategies. Excellent communication and client-facing skills with a consultative, solutions-oriented approach. Benefits: Competitive base salary estimated between $83,000 – $102,000 USD depending on experience and location Quarterly incentive and performance-based bonus opportunities Employer-matched 401(k) retirement savings plan Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage Stock or equity participation depending on role eligibility Generous paid time off and holiday schedule Professional development opportunities and career growth support Flexible remote work setup with collaborative team culture Wellness, recognition, and employee engagement programs

title: Senior Account Support Analyst - HMIG
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior Account Support Analyst - HMIG in United States. This role sits at the intersection of sales support, account management, and operational execution within a complex stop loss insurance environment. You will play a key role in supporting the full sales and renewal lifecycle by ensuring accurate group setup, smooth implementation of new business, and efficient resolution of account and benefit-related issues. Acting as a central point of coordination between sales teams, clients, producers, and internal stakeholders, you will help ensure seamless service delivery across all stages of the account journey. The position requires strong technical knowledge of stop loss or employer benefits administration, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting. You will also contribute to process improvements and support junior team members, helping strengthen overall team performance. This is a highly collaborative role where accuracy, responsiveness, and client focus directly impact business success. In this role, you will support the sales and account management teams by managing complex administrative processes across the stop loss sales and renewal lifecycle while ensuring data accuracy and service excellence. Load, update, and maintain group information and benefit files with high accuracy across internal systems. Support account managers and sales teams by resolving benefit inquiries and coordinating account activities. Manage RFP intake, renewal processes, and implementation tasks related to new and existing group accounts. Coordinate internal and external meetings, implementations, and client-related project activities. Identify and resolve errors in account files, ensuring compliance and data integrity. Analyze and support implementation of policy changes, benefit updates, and non-standard arrangements. Serve as a resource to less experienced colleagues and contribute to team knowledge sharing. Requirements: The ideal candidate brings strong experience in insurance, healthcare, or benefits administration with the ability to manage detailed operational processes in a client-facing environment. High school diploma or GED required. 5–10 years of progressive experience in account support, insurance operations, or related specialization. Strong understanding of stop loss, health insurance, or employer benefits administration preferred. Experience supporting sales teams, account managers, or client service functions. Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage and correct complex data and system records. Excellent communication and coordination skills for interacting with internal teams, producers, and clients. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a structured, fast-paced environment. Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on accuracy and process improvement. Experience in healthcare or insurance environments is strongly preferred. Benefits: Competitive salary range: $62,700 – $97,200 annually Opportunity to support a specialized stop loss insurance business unit Exposure to full sales lifecycle, including RFPs, renewals, and implementation processes Collaborative environment working closely with sales, underwriting, and client teams Career development opportunities in insurance operations and account management Stable, office-based role with structured processes and responsibilities Inclusive workplace with strong compliance and ethical standards Access to standard benefits including health coverage and employee support programs

title: Senior Accountant
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior Accountant in Canada. This role offers the opportunity to join a dynamic finance team within a global organization operating in a complex, asset-intensive industry. You will play a key part in ensuring accurate financial reporting across multiple entities while contributing to month-end close, statutory reporting, and audit processes. The environment is fast-paced, structured, and highly collaborative, with strong exposure to international operations and cross-functional stakeholders. You will work closely with systems such as Oracle and other financial tools to ensure data integrity and reporting accuracy. This position is ideal for a detail-oriented accounting professional who thrives in managing complexity and delivering high-quality financial insights. Beyond technical execution, the role also allows you to contribute to process improvements and the strengthening of internal controls within a growing and evolving finance function. Manage the full month-end close process for assigned entities, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting across multiple systems and reporting standards. Prepare consolidated financial statements, statutory reports, and supporting schedules in compliance with ASPE or IFRS requirements. Maintain and reconcile general ledger accounts, ensuring accuracy across high-volume and complex financial data sets. Record and review key financial transactions, including operating expenses, fuel costs, trade costs, accruals, and equity income from joint ventures. Support annual external audits, including preparation of documentation, analysis of impairments, and drafting of technical accounting position papers. Ensure proper system integration and reconciliation across financial tools such as Oracle, IMOS, and Concur. Maintain insurance claims accounting records and support related financial documentation and reporting. Contribute to the enhancement of accounting policies, internal controls, and process optimization initiatives. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field; CPA designation is considered an asset. 5+ years of relevant accounting experience, ideally within a large or complex organizational environment. Strong knowledge of ASPE and IFRS accounting standards with hands-on application experience. Advanced Excel skills, with familiarity in ERP systems such as Oracle and reporting tools like Power BI considered a plus. Strong analytical mindset with the ability to manage and interpret large and complex data sets. Proven experience in month-end close, financial reporting, reconciliations, and audit support activities. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain financial information to non-finance stakeholders. High level of accuracy, accountability, and ability to work effectively under tight deadlines in a structured environment. Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative and proactive working style. Benefits: Competitive compensation package with performance-based bonus opportunities. Comprehensive health and dental coverage, largely employer-paid. Life insurance coverage up to multiple times salary. Pension or RRSP retirement savings plan to support long-term financial security. Flexible work arrangements, including hybrid work with remote flexibility. Wellness support including gym membership allowance and employee wellbeing initiatives. Professional development opportunities, including training and career advancement support. Inclusive and diverse workplace culture focused on collaboration and growth.

title: Senior Accountant
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior Accountant in United States. This role offers a high-visibility opportunity within a fast-paced, mission-driven healthcare technology environment, where financial accuracy and operational excellence directly support the transformation of healthcare data systems. The Senior Accountant will play a key part in strengthening month-end close processes, ensuring compliance with US GAAP and SOX standards, and improving accounting workflows across a high-volume organization. Working closely with Finance, Accounting leadership, and cross-functional business teams, you will contribute to accurate reporting, financial insights, and scalable processes. The environment is dynamic and collaborative, requiring strong analytical thinking, adaptability, and ownership mindset. This is an ideal role for an experienced accounting professional who thrives in complexity and wants to contribute to meaningful impact in a high-growth organization. Manage due diligence processes, including title, survey, environmental, zoning, permitting, and regulatory analysis. Identify and mitigate legal and commercial risks related to site control, utilities, infrastructure, and jurisdictional constraints. Collaborate with internal teams across development, finance, engineering, and operations to ensure seamless deal execution. Experience working with capital structures, investment models, and financial return considerations. Ability to align legal strategy with business objectives and operational requirements. title: Senior Cost Accounting Manager

title: Senior Creative Designer
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior Creative Designer in the United States. This is a high-impact, zero-to-one creative role focused on shaping the emotional and visual identity of an AI-powered digital health experience. You will define how a product feels, moves, and connects with users managing chronic metabolic conditions such as type 2 diabetes and obesity. Working at the intersection of design, motion, and human-centered care, you will bring empathy and craft to every interaction across mobile and web platforms. The role sits within a fast-scaling health technology environment driven by AI innovation and clinical insight. You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, and care teams to translate abstract emotional concepts into elegant, functional experiences. This is an opportunity to influence not just design systems, but the “soul” of an AI-driven health product used to improve real patient outcomes. The environment is fast-moving, mission-driven, and deeply focused on improving lives at scale. Define the product’s emotional and visual language, shaping how users experience empathy, guidance, and connection through design, illustration, and motion. Create high-quality visual systems and interaction patterns that elevate usability, accessibility, and emotional engagement across digital health journeys. Design and prototype micro-interactions, motion behaviors, and transitions that make the product feel responsive, human, and alive. Develop creative concepts from zero-to-one, independently translating abstract ideas into polished, production-ready design solutions. Collaborate with product, engineering, and clinical teams to ensure seamless integration of motion assets and visual systems across iOS and Android platforms. Contribute to and refine lightweight animation workflows, ensuring scalability and performance through tools like Lottie and Rive. Balance creative ambition with execution speed, making thoughtful trade-offs to maintain momentum while preserving design integrity. Requirements 5+ years of experience in product design, creative design, motion design, or related roles within consumer-facing digital products. Strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in visual design, motion systems, illustration, and interactive experiences. Experience in high-quality consumer applications such as lifestyle, social, wellness, or entertainment products with strong visual storytelling. Advanced proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and motion/design tools such as After Effects, Jitter, or similar platforms. Experience producing and shipping motion assets using Lottie, Rive, or comparable frameworks. Strong understanding of micro-interactions, UX principles, and how motion influences engagement and user behavior. Ability to work autonomously in ambiguous environments and translate abstract emotional goals into concrete design outputs. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working closely with product and engineering teams. Benefits Competitive salary aligned with leading tech industry standards (USD 150,000–165,000 range). Remote-first work environment with a globally distributed team. Equity participation opportunities depending on role type and eligibility. Comprehensive health coverage including medical, dental, and vision insurance (with family coverage support). Unlimited paid time off with manager approval. Generous parental leave policies supporting both primary and secondary caregivers. 401(k) retirement savings plan. Flexible, mission-driven culture focused on work-life balance and impact-driven design.

title: Senior CRM Strategist
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior CRM Strategist in Netherlands. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly strategic and hands-on CRM expert to shape lifecycle marketing and retention strategies within a fast-growing global technology environment. In this role, you will work directly with mobile app businesses to improve user engagement, retention, and subscription performance through advanced CRM and lifecycle marketing initiatives. You will combine strategic consulting, data-driven experimentation, and operational execution to help customers build impactful engagement journeys across the subscriber lifecycle. Working cross-functionally with product, marketing, customer success, and advocacy teams, you will influence both customer outcomes and future platform capabilities. The position is ideal for someone passionate about mobile growth, retention optimization, and customer engagement systems at scale. With strong visibility and ownership, you will have the opportunity to become a recognized thought leader in lifecycle marketing while helping shape best practices for the broader mobile app ecosystem. Lead customer-facing CRM and lifecycle marketing engagements, including audits, strategy workshops, campaign planning, and retention optimization initiatives. Design and implement engagement frameworks focused on onboarding, trial conversion, churn prevention, win-back campaigns, and long-term subscriber retention. Advise customers on integrating subscription and behavioral data into CRM platforms to enable advanced segmentation, personalization, and automation strategies. Analyze customer lifecycle performance metrics, user cohorts, and engagement data to identify opportunities for growth and revenue optimization. Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to provide strategic feedback on CRM integrations, event triggers, data structures, and platform capabilities. Develop scalable playbooks, templates, and lifecycle marketing frameworks that can be reused across customer accounts and internal teams. Partner with advocacy, content, and marketing teams to create webinars, guides, thought leadership content, and educational resources for the mobile app community. Support internal enablement by helping sales, customer success, and support teams deepen their understanding of lifecycle marketing and retention strategies. Serve as a strategic advisor and visible expert on mobile engagement, subscription retention, and CRM best practices within the broader industry ecosystem. Requirements: 5 to 8+ years of hands-on experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or mobile engagement strategy, particularly within subscription-based mobile applications. Proven expertise with leading CRM and customer engagement platforms such as Braze, Iterable, OneSignal, CleverTap, Customer.io, or Airship. Strong experience designing, implementing, and measuring multi-step lifecycle campaigns, segmentation strategies, and retention-focused experiments. Advanced analytical capabilities with experience using data and product analytics tools to evaluate customer behavior, retention, and lifetime value performance. Deep understanding of mobile engagement best practices, including push notifications, in-app messaging, email campaigns, onboarding flows, and churn recovery strategies. Ability to confidently lead workshops, present strategic recommendations, and communicate effectively with both technical and executive stakeholders. Experience working in remote-first and asynchronous international environments with strong self-management and collaboration skills. Strong ownership mentality with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced, and evolving business environments. Experience with subscription app ecosystems, CRM infrastructure, or customer retention consulting is highly valued. Additional experience in thought leadership, public speaking, webinar hosting, or content creation related to lifecycle marketing is considered a strong advantage. Benefits: Competitive compensation package including equity opportunities within a rapidly growing global technology company. Long-term equity exercise window designed to support employee flexibility and ownership. Fully remote and flexible work environment with global collaboration opportunities. Generous annual time-off policy focused on personal well-being, mental health, and work-life balance. Workspace setup allowance to support productive and comfortable remote work. Annual professional development stipend for continuous learning and career growth. Opportunity to work on high-impact projects influencing millions of mobile app users worldwide. Exposure to innovative mobile growth, subscription, and lifecycle marketing technologies. Collaborative, international, and values-driven culture focused on ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement.

title: Senior Information Risk Consultant
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior Information Risk Consultant in United States. This role sits at the core of enterprise cybersecurity and governance, focusing on identifying, assessing, and mitigating information risks across complex technology and business environments. You will collaborate with architecture, engineering, compliance, and business teams to evaluate security posture and ensure alignment with industry frameworks and internal policies. The position blends hands-on risk assessment with strategic advisory responsibilities, requiring you to translate technical vulnerabilities into clear business impacts and actionable mitigation plans. You will also contribute to the continuous improvement of risk governance practices, including policy development, control validation, and compliance readiness. Lead information risk assessments by gathering documentation, conducting stakeholder interviews, and analyzing security controls and vulnerabilities. Evaluate and document risk scenarios, including likelihood, impact, threat vectors, and mitigation effectiveness. Communicate risk findings clearly to technical teams, management, and stakeholders, ensuring alignment on remediation actions. Maintain and contribute to enterprise risk registers, including tracking, scoring, and updating risk statements. Monitor remediation activities and ensure risk treatment plans are progressing effectively and within defined timelines. Partner with architecture and engineering teams to embed security requirements into solution design and enterprise initiatives. Support compliance with frameworks and standards such as HITRUST, NIST, PCI-DSS, and ISO 27001. Prepare and present risk and security reports to leadership and governance committees. Mentor team members and contribute to the development of risk management practices across the organization. Requirements: The ideal candidate brings deep experience in information security, risk management, and governance within complex, regulated environments. Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience). 7–10+ years of experience in information security, risk management, or cybersecurity governance. Strong knowledge of risk frameworks such as NIST, HITRUST, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and COBIT. Experience conducting security risk assessments and developing mitigation strategies. Familiarity with enterprise security technologies (e.g., firewalls, DLP, SIEM, endpoint protection, encryption). Strong communication skills with the ability to present technical risks to executive and non-technical audiences. title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer in Belgium. This Senior Infrastructure Engineer role is designed for a highly autonomous professional passionate about cloud infrastructure, open-source ecosystems, and scalable engineering practices. You will lead infrastructure initiatives across multi-cloud environments while contributing to the design, implementation, and long-term sustainability of reliable systems for both internal operations and client-facing projects. The position combines hands-on technical execution with architectural leadership, requiring strong expertise in automation, observability, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code. You will also collaborate closely with globally distributed engineering teams and contribute actively to open-source communities. The role offers the opportunity to work on modern cloud-native platforms, support data-intensive environments, and help organizations adopt scalable and maintainable infrastructure solutions. This is an ideal opportunity for engineers who thrive in transparent, collaborative, and deeply technical environments focused on innovation and open-source impact. Design, implement, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, ensuring reliability, security, and operational efficiency. Lead infrastructure architecture initiatives for internal systems and client engagements, managing projects from scoping through deployment and optimization. Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation. Manage Kubernetes environments and containerized workloads, including deployment automation and Helm chart maintenance. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automation workflows to improve deployment reliability and engineering productivity. Implement observability and monitoring solutions using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, and related platforms. Collaborate with client teams to transfer infrastructure knowledge and establish sustainable operational practices. Contribute to open-source projects and actively participate in technical communities related to infrastructure and cloud engineering. Support cloud security best practices including IAM/RBAC, secrets management, pipeline security, and infrastructure governance. Mentor team members and collaborate asynchronously within globally distributed engineering teams. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in Infrastructure Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or related fields. Strong experience working with at least two major cloud providers among AWS, Azure, and GCP, with familiarity across all three. Advanced expertise in Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and Helm chart development. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI, or similar tools. Strong knowledge of observability, monitoring, and logging solutions including Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK/OpenSearch stacks. Proficiency in Python or another scripting/programming language for automation and tooling. Experience with cloud security best practices including IAM, RBAC, secrets management, and secure pipelines. Strong understanding of Git, GitHub workflows, and remote asynchronous collaboration practices. Proven experience working directly with clients, translating technical requirements into scalable infrastructure solutions. Active open-source contributor or maintainer experience is strongly preferred. Familiarity with GitOps, MLOps, AI/ML infrastructure, SQL/databases, or configuration management tools such as Ansible is considered a plus. Opportunity to contribute directly to influential open-source projects and communities. Access to highly collaborative, transparent, and innovation-driven engineering culture. Exposure to cutting-edge cloud, AI/ML, and infrastructure technologies. Strong focus on professional growth, learning, and technical ownership.

This Senior Infrastructure Engineer role is designed for a highly autonomous professional passionate about cloud infrastructure, open-source ecosystems, and scalable engineering practices. You will lead infrastructure initiatives across multi-cloud environments while contributing to the design, implementation, and long-term sustainability of reliable systems for both internal operations and client-facing projects. The position combines hands-on technical execution with architectural leadership, requiring strong expertise in automation, observability, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code. You will also collaborate closely with globally distributed engineering teams and contribute actively to open-source communities. The role offers the opportunity to work on modern cloud-native platforms, support data-intensive environments, and help organizations adopt scalable and maintainable infrastructure solutions. This is an ideal opportunity for engineers who thrive in transparent, collaborative, and deeply technical environments focused on innovation and open-source impact. Design, implement, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, ensuring reliability, security, and operational efficiency. Lead infrastructure architecture initiatives for internal systems and client engagements, managing projects from scoping through deployment and optimization. Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation. Manage Kubernetes environments and containerized workloads, including deployment automation and Helm chart maintenance. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automation workflows to improve deployment reliability and engineering productivity. Implement observability and monitoring solutions using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, and related platforms. Collaborate with client teams to transfer infrastructure knowledge and establish sustainable operational practices. Contribute to open-source projects and actively participate in technical communities related to infrastructure and cloud engineering. Support cloud security best practices including IAM/RBAC, secrets management, pipeline security, and infrastructure governance. Mentor team members and collaborate asynchronously within globally distributed engineering teams. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in Infrastructure Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or related fields. Strong experience working with at least two major cloud providers among AWS, Azure, and GCP, with familiarity across all three. Advanced expertise in Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and Helm chart development. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI, or similar tools. Strong knowledge of observability, monitoring, and logging solutions including Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK/OpenSearch stacks. Proficiency in Python or another scripting/programming language for automation and tooling. Experience with cloud security best practices including IAM, RBAC, secrets management, and secure pipelines. Strong understanding of Git, GitHub workflows, and remote asynchronous collaboration practices. Proven experience working directly with clients, translating technical requirements into scalable infrastructure solutions. Active open-source contributor or maintainer experience is strongly preferred. Familiarity with GitOps, MLOps, AI/ML infrastructure, SQL/databases, or configuration management tools such as Ansible is considered a plus. Benefits: Fully remote work environment with global collaboration opportunities. Competitive compensation package based on experience and location. Performance-based bonus opportunities. Comprehensive health and benefits package where applicable. Flexible work schedules with emphasis on work-life balance. Generous paid time off, sick leave, and parental leave policies. Opportunity to contribute directly to influential open-source projects and communities. Access to highly collaborative, transparent, and innovation-driven engineering culture. Exposure to cutting-edge cloud, AI/ML, and infrastructure technologies. Strong focus on professional growth, learning, and technical ownership.

Step into a high-impact leadership role at the intersection of revenue strategy, analytics, and operational excellence within a globally distributed and innovation-driven environment. This position offers the opportunity to shape how go-to-market performance is measured, optimized, and scaled across international sales organizations. You will lead strategic analytics initiatives that directly influence forecasting accuracy, revenue growth, and operational efficiency while partnering closely with senior commercial leadership. The role combines hands-on technical expertise with strategic planning, enabling you to build scalable data frameworks and predictive models that support business expansion. Working in a fully remote and asynchronous culture, you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams worldwide while mentoring analytics professionals and driving data governance initiatives. This is an ideal opportunity for a commercially minded analytics leader who thrives in fast-paced SaaS environments and enjoys transforming complex data into actionable business decisions. Lead the execution and evolution of GTM analytics and planning strategies to support a global multi-segment sales organization. Build and maintain scalable data models, dashboards, and reporting frameworks that serve as the central source of truth for revenue operations. Oversee sales performance measurement, including analysis of win rates, sales cycles, churn risk, funnel efficiency, and revenue forecasting. Drive annual and quarterly GTM planning initiatives, including territory planning, quota setting, headcount modeling, and capacity forecasting. Partner with Marketing Analytics and Revenue Operations teams to create unified end-to-end visibility across the customer acquisition funnel. Develop predictive models and analytical frameworks to support proactive decision-making and revenue pacing adjustments. Ensure high standards of data governance, integrity, and operational consistency across commercial reporting systems. Collaborate with executive stakeholders to translate complex analytical insights into strategic recommendations and actionable business narratives. Mentor and manage a team of GTM analysts, fostering technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation tools to optimize GTM workflows, sales intelligence, and operational processes. Requirements: Significant experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Analytics, Business Intelligence, or related functions within high-growth B2B SaaS organizations. Proven expertise in GTM planning processes, including quota modeling, sales capacity planning, territory management, and forecasting. Strong technical proficiency with Snowflake, dbt, SQL, and BI platforms such as Tableau or Sigma. Experience using Python or R for advanced modeling, statistical analysis, and forecasting initiatives. Deep understanding of Salesforce CRM and full-funnel sales processes, including SDR/BDR, partnerships, and account management lifecycles. Experience leveraging AI and automation tools to improve analytics, lead routing, workflow efficiency, or commercial operations. Strong analytical mindset with expertise in regression analysis, trend forecasting, and sales performance modeling. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to present executive-level insights clearly and effectively. Leadership experience managing and mentoring analytics or RevOps teams in fast-paced and globally distributed environments. Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal. Ability to thrive in asynchronous remote work settings with a proactive, action-oriented approach. Benefits: Fully remote work environment with the flexibility to work from anywhere. Flexible working hours within an asynchronous work culture that supports work-life balance. Competitive compensation package with globally equitable salary practices. Stock options and performance-focused growth opportunities. Flexible paid time off policy. 16 weeks of paid parental leave. Mental health and wellness support services. Dedicated learning and professional development budget. Home office budget and company-provided IT equipment. Budget for coworking spaces and local in-person social events. Opportunity to work with globally distributed teams across multiple continents in an innovative SaaS environment.

title: Senior Manager, Machine Learning
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior Manager, Machine Learning in India. This role sits at the intersection of advanced machine learning, product innovation, and large-scale conversational systems, driving the next generation of AI-powered customer engagement. You will lead the design and development of foundational ML platform capabilities that enable developers to build context-aware, intelligent communication experiences. Acting as a “player-coach,” you will combine hands-on technical contribution with strategic leadership, guiding a high-performing engineering team in a fast-paced, experimentation-driven environment. The position plays a critical role in transforming ambiguous business needs into scalable ML solutions with measurable impact. You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders across product, engineering, and business teams to define priorities and shape the roadmap. This is a highly visible role where your work directly influences platform direction and innovation at scale. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end development of machine learning platform capabilities, ensuring alignment between business goals, product vision, and technical execution. You will define and execute ML roadmaps, guide experimentation, and drive the delivery of scalable AI solutions. Translate ambiguous business problems into clear, prioritized machine learning product and platform roadmaps. Lead the design, development, and deployment of production-grade ML systems, including LLM-based and conversational AI solutions. Act as a hands-on technical leader (“player-coach”), contributing to architecture, experimentation, and model development. Build and optimize ML engineering infrastructure, enabling rapid iteration, experimentation, and deployment at scale. Define KPIs and success metrics to evaluate ML model performance and business impact. Manage project delivery, including timelines, dependencies, risks, and cross-functional alignment. Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing ML engineers while fostering a culture of innovation and ownership. Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment and execution of strategic goals. Requirements The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in applied machine learning, strong leadership experience, and a proven track record of building and scaling production ML systems. You combine technical depth with strategic thinking and strong communication skills. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (advanced degree preferred). 10+ years of experience in Applied Machine Learning or AI, including 3+ years in a leadership role managing ML engineers or data scientists. Proven experience building and scaling large-scale ML platforms or AI-driven products. Deep expertise in production ML systems, including LLM orchestration, embeddings, vector databases, and conversational AI systems. Strong experience with MLOps/LLMOps practices, including evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems. Solid background in cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, and large-scale data systems. Demonstrated ability to define technical strategy and influence product direction in cross-functional environments. Excellent communication, mentoring, and stakeholder management skills. Experience in hiring and scaling technical teams in fast-growing environments. Benefits Competitive compensation package aligned with senior leadership roles Remote-first work flexibility within India-based locations Comprehensive health insurance coverage Paid time off, parental leave, and wellness support programs Opportunities for learning, leadership development, and career growth Exposure to cutting-edge AI/ML technologies and large-scale systems Inclusive and collaborative work culture focused on innovation

title: Senior Manager, North America Field Marketing
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior Manager, North America Field Marketing in United States. This role is a high-impact regional marketing leadership position focused on driving measurable pipeline growth and revenue contribution across North America. You will lead the execution of integrated field marketing strategies that connect demand generation, events, account-based marketing, and partner initiatives into a cohesive regional engine. Acting as a key marketing partner to sales leadership, you will help shape go-to-market priorities and ensure marketing investments directly support pipeline creation and acceleration. The role combines strategic planning with hands-on execution, requiring someone who can operate effectively across programs, budgets, and cross-functional stakeholders. You will also play a central role in localizing global campaigns and activating regional initiatives that resonate with Mid-Market, Enterprise, and Commercial segments. This is a fast-paced, data-driven environment where performance, agility, and collaboration are essential. You will contribute directly to improving marketing efficiency, conversion rates, and overall revenue impact across the region. In this role, you will lead the execution of field marketing programs across North America, ensuring strong alignment with sales priorities and measurable impact on pipeline creation and revenue outcomes. You will balance strategic planning with hands-on delivery while optimizing marketing investments across channels and initiatives. Execute integrated field marketing programs designed to generate qualified pipeline and accelerate deal progression. Partner closely with sales leadership to align on regional priorities and develop joint marketing and revenue plans. Deliver and localize global campaigns, ensuring effective adaptation for North American audiences and segments. Plan and manage field events, account-based marketing initiatives, and customer engagement programs. Oversee field marketing budget allocation, optimizing spend to maximize pipeline impact and ROI. Collaborate with channel and partner marketing teams to support co-marketing and ecosystem activation. Experience supporting or managing audit activities, including coordination with external auditors and regulatory bodies. Ability to produce high-quality technical documentation related to cloud security and compliance controls. Strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritize, track, and deliver multiple compliance workstreams in parallel. title: Senior Product Designer - Finance and Reporting
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior Product Designer - Finance and Reporting in Switzerland. This is a high-impact opportunity for an experienced product designer to shape the future of financial reporting tools within a fast-growing, global SaaS environment. In this role, you will transform complex financial and operational data into intuitive, user-friendly experiences that empower property managers to make faster and more informed decisions. You will own the end-to-end design process for finance dashboards and reporting features, working closely with product, engineering, and research teams in a highly collaborative and remote-first environment. The position requires a strong balance of systems thinking, data visualization expertise, and user-centric design excellence. Ideal for a designer who thrives in complexity, this role offers the chance to define scalable financial UX solutions and influence product direction at a strategic level. Lead the end-to-end design process for finance dashboards and reporting features, from discovery and research to prototyping, testing, and final delivery. Translate complex financial and operational requirements into clear, intuitive, and user-centered design solutions. Conduct qualitative and quantitative user research to understand user needs, behaviors, and pain points in financial workflows. Design advanced data visualizations and reporting interfaces that simplify complex datasets into actionable insights. Create user journeys, service blueprints, and system maps to structure and clarify financial processes such as trust accounting. Develop interactive prototypes and high-fidelity designs, iterating based on user feedback and usability testing. Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and successful implementation of designs. Contribute to and maintain design systems, ensuring consistency, scalability, and high-quality user experience across products. Facilitate workshops and collaborative sessions to align stakeholders, generate ideas, and support decision-making. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in product design, ideally within a B2B SaaS or data-heavy product environment. Strong experience designing financial dashboards, reporting tools, or complex data visualization interfaces. Deep understanding of the full design thinking process, including research, ideation, prototyping, and delivery. Strong skills in user research, storytelling, journey mapping, and service blueprinting. Excellent visual and UI design skills with strong attention to hierarchy, clarity, and data presentation. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including auto-layout and modern design workflows. Familiarity with AI tools for research, ideation, prototyping, and design acceleration. Experience working in agile environments and managing multiple design projects simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across distributed teams. Bonus: experience with vibecoding or design-to-code workflows. Benefits: Fully remote role within the EMEA region with flexible working arrangements. Competitive compensation aligned with local market standards. Equity participation through stock options in a high-growth SaaS company. Flexible work environment with autonomy over location and working setup. Strong focus on professional growth, learning, and career development opportunities. Annual paid leave aligned with country-specific regulations. Country-specific benefits such as health insurance and pension contributions where applicable. Inclusive and diverse global team culture spanning 40+ countries. Values-driven environment emphasizing collaboration, innovation, and transparency.

Fast-paced, highly collaborative startup environment focused on rapid experimentation and continuous learning. title: Senior Project Coordinator
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior Project Coordinator in France. Join a dynamic clinical research environment supporting global studies across multiple therapeutic areas and international markets. This role offers the opportunity to play a key part in coordinating site activation and study operations throughout the full clinical trial lifecycle. Working closely with project managers, clinical teams, research sites, and cross-functional stakeholders, you will help ensure operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and timely project delivery. The position combines project coordination, site communication, documentation management, and process optimization within a fast-paced and highly collaborative setting. You will contribute directly to the successful execution of clinical trials while supporting continuous improvement initiatives and mentoring junior team members. This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented clinical research professional seeking strong career growth within a globally connected remote work environment. Coordinate and support site activation activities, ensuring timelines, quality standards, and regulatory requirements are consistently achieved throughout clinical trial phases. Prepare investigator sites for study initiation by collecting, reviewing, approving, and maintaining essential regulatory and clinical documentation. Serve as a key communication point between clinical sites, project teams, CRAs, and external stakeholders to ensure alignment on study priorities and deliverables. Maintain and organize study documentation within electronic Trial Master Files (eTMF) and other project tracking systems. Assist with ethics submissions, study material distribution, training coordination, and investigator meeting preparation activities. Monitor project timelines, site activation progress, enrollment tracking tools, study inventories, and payment reconciliation processes. Escalate risks or delays affecting study timelines to project leadership while proactively supporting issue resolution and operational continuity. Support audits, inspections, corrective action planning, and process improvement initiatives to strengthen project efficiency and compliance standards. Mentor junior Project Coordinators and contribute to onboarding, training material development, and departmental knowledge-sharing activities when required. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in a field related to clinical research, life sciences, healthcare, or equivalent professional experience. Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Project Coordinator or in a similar role within clinical research, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or CRO environments. Proven experience supporting site start-up and clinical trial coordination within global or multi-regional studies. Strong understanding of essential clinical trial documentation, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable regulatory requirements and guidelines. Excellent organizational, communication, multitasking, and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail. Ability to prioritize multiple assignments effectively and adapt quickly within fast-paced project environments. Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal; additional European or Asian language skills are considered an asset. Experience supporting regulatory submissions, project tracking, vendor coordination, or audit preparation is highly valued. Collaborative mindset with the ability to work independently while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships in remote environments. Benefits: Fully remote work opportunity within European locations. Flexible work schedule supporting work-life balance and productivity. Permanent full-time employment with long-term career stability. Comprehensive company benefits package. Ongoing learning, training, and professional development opportunities. Exposure to international clinical research projects and multidisciplinary collaboration. Career advancement opportunities within a growing and innovation-driven organization. Supportive and collaborative work culture focused on reliability, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.

content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer in South Africa. In this role, you will play a key part in strengthening software quality across modern cloud-based platforms and microservices environments while enabling fast, reliable software delivery. Working closely with developers, DevOps engineers, and product teams within Agile Scrum environments, you will help embed quality practices throughout the entire development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a final step. This opportunity is ideal for someone passionate about shift-left testing, exploratory quality engineering, and improving engineering standards through collaboration and automation. You’ll contribute to scalable CI/CD workflows, support developer-led automated testing strategies, and help identify risks and system issues early in the process. The position offers the chance to influence engineering practices, improve testing reliability, and drive continuous delivery excellence within a highly collaborative and modern technical environment. If you enjoy combining technical depth with strategic quality thinking, this role offers meaningful impact and long-term growth opportunities. Collaborate within Agile Scrum teams to embed quality engineering practices early in the software development lifecycle. Support developers in building and improving automated testing strategies including unit, API, integration, and performance testing. Promote shift-left testing methodologies to identify defects and system risks as early as possible. Perform exploratory, risk-based, and end-to-end testing where automation alone is insufficient. Identify edge cases, integration risks, and quality concerns across distributed microservices architectures. Contribute to the enhancement of test automation frameworks and CI/CD testing workflows. Help improve the reliability and effectiveness of automated pipelines by reducing flaky tests and strengthening feedback mechanisms. Participate actively in backlog refinement, sprint planning, retrospectives, and quality-focused discussions. Collaborate with developers and QA peers to raise quality engineering standards and share best practices across teams. Translate technical testing findings into clear recommendations, risks, and actionable insights for stakeholders. Requirements: Proven experience working within Agile development teams where quality is treated as a shared engineering responsibility. Strong understanding of shift-left testing principles and developer-led automation practices. Hands-on experience with test automation in .NET and C# environments. Familiarity with UI automation tools such as Selenium. Experience working with BDD frameworks including Reqnroll or similar solutions. Knowledge of testing frameworks such as NUnit, xUnit, or MSTest. Experience with API testing using REST, Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, or similar tools. Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated testing workflows. Knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as SQL Server or MySQL. Familiarity with cloud environments, ideally Microsoft Azure, and microservices-based architectures. Experience with Docker, contract testing, performance testing tools like K6, or feature-flag-driven development is advantageous. Strong communication, collaboration, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Ability to influence engineering practices and work closely with developers to improve software quality outcomes. Benefits: Opportunity to work within a modern engineering environment focused on CI/CD, cloud technologies, and microservices. Collaborative Agile culture where quality engineering is treated as a shared responsibility across teams. Exposure to advanced automation practices and modern software delivery methodologies. Ability to contribute directly to engineering standards, testing strategies, and delivery excellence. Flexible and collaborative work environment with opportunities for professional growth. High-impact role within cross-functional engineering teams focused on innovation and continuous improvement. content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Salesforce) in Spain. This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of scalable and high-performing Salesforce solutions within a fast-moving and innovation-focused environment. As a senior engineer, you will play a key role in designing, building, and optimizing enterprise Salesforce applications that support both internal operations and customer-facing initiatives. The position combines hands-on technical work with collaboration across product, architecture, and business teams to deliver impactful solutions. You will help shape engineering standards, improve development workflows, and drive technical excellence through modern Agile practices. The role also encourages the use of AI-powered development tools to enhance productivity, problem-solving, and software delivery. This is an ideal opportunity for a proactive and technically strong professional seeking growth, flexibility, and the chance to work in a collaborative international environment. Design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and broader Salesforce platform capabilities. Contribute actively to Agile sprint execution by supporting development goals, maintaining delivery velocity, and ensuring successful completion of engineering tasks. Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code aligned with SOLID principles and Salesforce engineering best practices. Conduct code reviews and contribute to engineering quality initiatives to minimize defects and improve software reliability. Build and maintain integrations using REST and SOAP APIs while ensuring scalability, security, and performance optimization. Utilize AI-powered development tools and workflows to accelerate coding, troubleshooting, technical documentation, and problem-solving. Collaborate closely with architects, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver impactful Salesforce solutions. Identify technical risks early, recommend mitigation strategies, and communicate project progress clearly to relevant stakeholders. Support CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, Salesforce CLI tooling, and deployment processes to maintain efficient software delivery operations. Requirements: Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce engineering, including Apex development, triggers, asynchronous processing, and batch or scheduled jobs. Proven expertise with Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flows, custom object development, automation tools, and scalable data architecture. Strong understanding of SOQL/SOSL queries, Salesforce governor limits, performance optimization, and scalability best practices. Experience building and maintaining integrations using REST/SOAP APIs with knowledge of authentication and platform security principles. Familiarity with deployment tooling, Git version control, Salesforce CLI, and CI/CD pipeline environments. Commitment to engineering excellence, including testing, maintainable code, peer code reviews, and technical documentation. title: Senior Syslog Engineer
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior Syslog Engineer in India. You will play a critical role in building scalable, resilient, and high-performance logging pipelines capable of handling massive event volumes with reliability and precision. The role combines deep expertise in syslog-ng, SIEM integrations, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and distributed data pipeline engineering. You will collaborate with security operations, platform engineering, and infrastructure teams to ensure efficient log routing, normalization, and ingestion across enterprise systems. Design, implement, and optimize high-throughput syslog-ng configurations and log ingestion architectures. Develop advanced filtering, routing, and parsing logic to improve log quality, normalization, and noise reduction. Monitor and optimize pipeline performance related to CPU usage, memory consumption, throughput, buffering, and latency. Build scalable, fault-tolerant, and resilient syslog infrastructures capable of processing high event-per-second (EPS) workloads. Troubleshoot ingestion issues including message loss, duplication, out-of-order events, backpressure, and network-related failures. Optimize buffering, batching, flow control, and disk-based queue management mechanisms within syslog-ng environments. Collaborate with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, ELK, or QRadar to ensure seamless data ingestion and integration. Implement best practices for structured and unstructured log parsing, secure syslog transmission, and protocol compliance. Conduct capacity planning, load testing, and performance validation for enterprise-scale logging systems. Develop reusable test frameworks, standards, documentation, and configuration guidelines for syslog environments. Support data enrichment, normalization, and integration with distributed streaming and analytics pipelines. Strong understanding of syslog protocols and standards, including RFC3164, RFC5424, TCP, UDP, and TLS-based ingestion. Supportive and inclusive work environment with long-term growth opportunities.

This role is focused on driving strategic growth across a portfolio of high-value merchant accounts within the payments and fintech ecosystem. You will act as a trusted business partner to clients, moving beyond traditional account management to actively identify revenue opportunities, optimize payment performance, and expand commercial relationships. The position sits at the intersection of finance, technology, and business strategy, requiring a strong analytical and commercial mindset. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, legal, and finance to ensure seamless service delivery and continuous improvement. Success in this role depends on your ability to interpret transaction data, detect performance gaps, and convert insights into growth actions. This is a high-impact, revenue-driven position in a fast-moving, global fintech environment. Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic merchant accounts, focusing on retention, performance optimization, and revenue expansion. Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities by analyzing transaction flows, payment performance, and client business needs. Conduct regular business reviews (QBRs) with key stakeholders to align on performance, growth strategies, and product adoption. Monitor key payment KPIs such as approval rates, conversion rates, and transaction volumes, proactively addressing performance issues. Act as the main point of contact for merchants, building long-term strategic relationships and acting as a trusted advisor. Collaborate with internal teams including Product, Engineering, Support, Legal, and Finance to resolve issues and enhance client experience. Translate client feedback and market insights into actionable recommendations to improve product offerings and conversion performance. Lead data-driven discussions focused on ROI, revenue growth, and optimization opportunities across the portfolio. Requirements: 4+ years of experience in Account Management, Business Development, or Customer Success within FinTech or Payments industries. Strong understanding of payment ecosystems, merchant lifecycle, and transaction flows. Proven ability to drive revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and commercial negotiations. Advanced analytical skills with the ability to interpret transaction data and identify performance trends. Experience working with KPIs such as conversion rates, approval rates, and processing volumes. Strong communication skills in English and Russian (mandatory), with ability to manage international stakeholders. High emotional intelligence, strong organizational skills, and ability to prioritize in fast-paced environments. Commercial mindset with a proactive, ownership-driven approach to account growth. Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams. Benefits: Competitive salary with performance-based incentives. Opportunity to manage high-impact, high-volume merchant portfolios. Global exposure to international clients in regulated fintech and crypto environments. Collaborative, product-driven culture with transparent communication. Strong career growth opportunities within a scaling organization. Cross-functional collaboration with experienced teams across product, engineering, and operations. Direct impact on company revenue and strategic growth initiatives.

title: Sustainability Certification Auditor
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Sustainability Certification Auditor in Portugal. This role plays a key part in ensuring the integrity, transparency, and credibility of one of the world’s leading sustainability certification systems. You will be responsible for conducting independent assessments of certified organizations and certification bodies across complex global supply chains. Working both on-site and remotely, you will verify compliance with sustainability, traceability, and greenhouse gas reduction standards. The position requires strong analytical capabilities, a deep understanding of certification frameworks, and the ability to evaluate environmental and social impacts across diverse industries. You will engage with stakeholders across Europe and North America, contributing directly to improving sustainability practices in global markets. This is a highly independent role where precision, objectivity, and integrity are essential. Conduct on-site and remote integrity assessments of certified companies and certification bodies in coordination with central teams Plan, prepare, and organize audit schedules and assessment activities across multiple regions and sectors Evaluate compliance with sustainability standards, including traceability systems, mass balances, and greenhouse gas reduction criteria Review complex supply chains covering waste, residues, agricultural feedstocks, processing facilities, and trading entities Assess social compliance aspects, including human rights, labor conditions, and environmental protection practices Prepare detailed integrity assessment reports and documentation of findings Conduct witness audits and evaluate auditor performance against established certification standards Contribute to the continuous improvement of certification systems and integrity programs Requirements: Minimum 5 years of experience in certification, auditing, or quality management (audit experience is mandatory) University degree in environmental sciences, chemistry, bioenergy, engineering, or a related field Strong background in auditing traceability systems, mass balance, sustainability criteria, or greenhouse gas accounting Experience with waste/residue-based biofuel or agricultural supply chains is highly valued Knowledge of chemical industry processes or circular economy principles is an advantage Strong understanding of human rights frameworks and social compliance standards (e.g., ILO, UN Global Compact) High level of independence and strict adherence to conflict-of-interest requirements Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills Strong command of English; additional languages are an advantage Proficiency in MS Office tools and digital audit systems for remote assessments Willingness to travel extensively within Europe or North America Benefits: Competitive compensation package Fully remote work with flexible working hours Structured onboarding and training support Opportunity to work independently and shape audit and integrity processes Collaboration with specialized sister organizations in sustainability and risk assessment Strong professional development and international exposure Meaningful role contributing directly to global sustainability and carbon reduction efforts

title: Team Lead of Content Moderators (PH)
content: This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Team Lead of Content Moderators (PH) in Australia. This role is ideal for a proactive and detail-oriented leader who thrives in fast-paced digital environments and is passionate about online safety and policy enforcement. As Team Lead of Content Moderators, you will oversee daily moderation operations, support a distributed team, and help ensure consistent application of platform guidelines across sensitive and high-impact content areas. You will play a key role in maintaining quality standards, improving workflows, and escalating complex moderation cases when needed. The position combines people leadership, operational oversight, and analytical thinking in a collaborative remote-first setting. This is an opportunity to contribute to a globally operating organization while working with modern moderation practices and cross-functional teams focused on continuous improvement and user trust. Supervise day-to-day moderation operations, ensuring team members consistently meet productivity, quality, and compliance targets. Provide hands-on guidance for complex or high-risk moderation cases, helping team members apply policies accurately and consistently. Monitor performance metrics and moderation trends to identify opportunities for operational improvements and enhanced decision-making. Coordinate scheduling and workflow distribution to maintain balanced workloads and timely task completion across the team. Support onboarding and ongoing training initiatives, reinforcing best practices and promoting continuous learning. Conduct moderation audits to ensure consistency, identify policy gaps, and maintain high standards of enforcement accuracy. Serve as an escalation point for challenging cases and internal team concerns, facilitating effective and timely resolutions. Collaborate with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to improve moderation processes and strengthen trust and safety strategies. Requirements: 2–4 years of leadership experience within content moderation, compliance, trust & safety, regulatory affairs, or policy-related environments. Strong understanding of sensitive online content areas, including hate speech, violent extremism, self-harm, fraud, exploitation, and misinformation. Demonstrated ability to interpret and enforce platform policies with consistency, sound judgment, and professionalism. Experience analyzing moderation data, performance metrics, and operational trends to support process improvements. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to provide clear feedback and direction to team members. Comfortable working in a fully remote environment with strong organizational and time-management skills. High level of integrity, resilience, and emotional maturity when handling sensitive or high-risk content. Strong computer literacy and confidence using digital tools, moderation systems, and reporting platforms. Willingness to work with adult-content platforms and enforce policies within regulated content environments. Benefits: Competitive compensation package of up to $1,200 USD per month Performance-based bonus system Paid vacation and sick leave Fully remote work environment with flexible work-from-home setup Learning and professional development opportunities Wellness and sports-related programs Opportunity to join a globally recognized and fast-growing company in the digital content industry Collaborative, supportive, and international team culture
